entries.name: AppShell
entries.title: App Shell
entries.description: AppShell is the page shell for an application. It provides slots for top navigation, side navigation, banners, and main content. Use it as the root wrapper for every page. It handles responsive mobile navigation and skip-to-content automatically. Configure side nav collapse on SideNav with its collapsible prop.

entries.name: AspectRatio
entries.title: Aspect Ratio
entries.description: Maintains a fixed width-to-height ratio for its children as its container resizes. Use it for media containers like videos, images, thumbnails, or any content that needs consistent proportions. It takes its width from the container and derives its height from the ratio, so it needs an ancestor with a definite width.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.title: Avatar
entries.description: Avatar represents a person or team with a profile photo, initials, or a default icon. Use it in comment headers, contact lists, chat messages, user cards, and anywhere you need to identify someone visually.

entries.name: AvatarGroup
entries.title: Avatar Group
entries.description: AvatarGroup displays multiple avatars in an overlapping row with an optional overflow indicator. Uses a compositional API: pass Avatar children directly so each avatar can carry its own props (status dots, click handlers, etc.).

entries.name: AvatarGroupOverflow
entries.title: Avatar Group Overflow
entries.description: AvatarGroupOverflow appears at the end of an AvatarGroup to summarize people who are not shown individually. Use it when a group is sliced to a small number of visible avatars but the hidden count still matters.

entries.name: AvatarStatusDot
entries.title: Avatar Status Dot
entries.description: Size-aware status indicator dot that reads avatar size from context and scales proportionally. Each variant pairs a colour with a distinct built-in shape (filled, ring, minus) so status is never conveyed by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

entries.name: Badge
entries.title: Badge
entries.description: Badge highlights a status or category at a glance. Use it sparingly: only when a value represents a distinct state (Active, Failed) or a grouping tag (Engineering, Design). Most metadata (dates, durations, counts, descriptions) should be plain description text, not badges.

entries.name: Banner
entries.title: Banner
entries.description: Banner shows a persistent message at the top of a page or section. Use it for form errors, system updates, maintenance notices, or success confirmations that the user needs to see until they act on it.

entries.name: Blockquote
entries.title: Blockquote
entries.description: A quotation block with a rule on its inline-start edge and secondary text color. Use to highlight quoted content, testimonials, or excerpts. The rule and padding are logical, so they move to the right edge in right-to-left locales.

entries.name: BottomSheet
entries.title: Bottom Sheet
entries.description: A mobile touch surface for filters, actions, forms, and detail views that should rise from the bottom of the viewport. For a multi-step flow, give each step its own sheet and one state value that names the open step (see Replacing a sheet); open a second sheet over the first when a step should stay visible beneath it.…

entries.name: BottomSheetSwitcher
entries.title: Bottom Sheet Switcher
entries.description: Deprecated: write each step as its own BottomSheet with isOpen, controlled by one state value that names the open step. Closing the top sheet and opening the next in the same update, from a control inside the open step, runs the same replace handoff (see BottomSheet, Replacing a sheet), with no sheetId and no switcher…

entries.name: BreadcrumbItem
entries.title: Breadcrumb Item
entries.description: BreadcrumbItem represents one destination, action, current location, or sibling-menu trigger inside a Breadcrumbs trail.

entries.name: Breadcrumbs
entries.title: Breadcrumbs
entries.description: Breadcrumbs show a trail of links from the root to the current page. Use them at the top of detail pages, settings panels, or anywhere the user needs to see where they are and navigate back up.

entries.name: Button
entries.title: Button
entries.description: Button triggers an action when clicked. Use it for form submissions, confirmations, navigation, or any interaction that needs a clear call to action.

entries.name: ButtonGroup
entries.title: Button Group
entries.description: ButtonGroup joins related actions into a single connected control. Use it when multiple buttons represent related choices or operations that belong together visually, like copy/cut/paste, or undo/redo.

entries.name: IconButton
entries.title: Icon Button
entries.description: A button that shows only an icon with no visible text. Use IconButton in toolbars, table rows, and compact UI where space is tight and the icon is universally understood.

entries.name: ToggleButton
entries.title: Toggle Button
entries.description: ToggleButton switches between selected and unselected states to represent a persistent on/off choice. Use it standalone for binary actions like bold, mute, or favorite, or inside a ToggleButtonGroup for single-select or multi-select toolbar controls.

entries.name: ToggleButtonGroup
entries.title: Toggle Button Group
entries.description: Groups toggle buttons for exclusive (single) or multi-select behavior. Uses discriminated union on type for type-safe value/onChange. Under the touch presentation a press tracks like a menu: press a toggle and slide across the others, and the highlight follows. Only the toggle you lift on toggles, and lifting outside…

entries.name: Calendar
entries.title: Calendar
entries.description: Calendar lets the user pick a date or date range from a month grid. Use it in booking flows, scheduling UIs, date filters, or anywhere the user needs to see surrounding dates for context.

entries.name: Card
entries.title: Card
entries.description: Card is a bordered, elevated container for discrete, self-contained items: things you could reorder, remove, or interact with independently. Cards are NOT the default layout tool. Most content groups don't need a container at all; spacing and alignment create visual grouping naturally. Only reach for a Card when items…

entries.name: ClickableCard
entries.title: Clickable Card
entries.description: An interactive card for navigation or action targets. Nested interactive elements work independently.

entries.name: SelectableCard
entries.title: Selectable Card
entries.description: A card that toggles between selected and unselected states with an accent border. For navigation use ClickableCard.

entries.name: Carousel
entries.title: Carousel
entries.description: Carousel scrolls a row of items horizontally when they overflow the available width. Use it for card grids, image galleries, product lists, or any set of items that should be browsable without taking up the full page.

entries.name: ChatComposer
entries.title: Chat Composer
entries.description: ChatComposer is the message-entry shell for a chat surface. It coordinates a controlled or uncontrolled draft, provides a default token-capable input and send/stop action, and arranges optional drawer, header, footer, and status content. Custom inputs and send controls can join the same value, submission, disabled, st…

entries.name: ChatComposerDrawer
entries.title: Chat Composer Drawer
entries.description: Use ChatComposerDrawer in the ChatComposer drawer slot for supplementary content such as attachments, context chips, or previews. Provide count only when people should be able to collapse that content.

entries.name: ChatComposerInput
entries.title: Chat Composer Input
entries.description: Pass ChatComposerInput to ChatComposer's input slot when the draft needs trigger menus, inline tokens, history recall, dictation insertion, or file intake.

entries.name: ChatDictationButton
entries.title: Chat Dictation Button
entries.description: ChatDictationButton is a toggle button that starts and stops voice dictation inside a chat composer. It pairs with useChatDictation to show a microphone icon when idle and animated frequency bars when listening. Place it in the sendActions slot of ChatComposer.

entries.name: ChatLayout
entries.title: Chat Layout
entries.description: ChatLayout is the layout shell for full-page chat interfaces. It renders messages in normal page flow and docks the composer to the bottom with a frosted glass blur layer. Set the density prop to control spacing; it defaults to balanced. Use it to wrap ChatMessageList and ChatComposer for a complete chat experience wi…

entries.name: ChatLayoutScrollButton
entries.title: Chat Layout Scroll Button
entries.description: Floating scroll-to-bottom button that appears when the user scrolls away from the latest messages. It fades in as a compact icon button and expands to show a label when new messages arrive. ChatLayout renders this by default: pass a custom element to the scrollButton prop to override, or null to hide it entirely.

entries.name: ChatMessage
entries.title: Chat Message
entries.description: Sender context wrapper: handles avatar, name, metadata, and alignment based on sender role.

entries.name: ChatMessageBubble
entries.title: Chat Message Bubble
entries.description: Styled content container for the chat "bubble." Reads sender from parent ChatMessage context to auto-style the background. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visible boundary. Supports name/metadata slots aligned with bubble padding, and multi-bubble grouping via the grou…

entries.name: ChatMessageList
entries.title: Chat Message List
entries.description: Presentational message container with density context and infinite scroll support. Provides role="log" with aria-live="polite" for accessibility. A flex spacer pushes messages to the bottom when the list isn't full; set align="top" to start messages at the top instead.

entries.name: ChatMessageMetadata
entries.title: Chat Message Metadata
entries.description: Place ChatMessageMetadata below a message or in the last ChatMessageBubble metadata slot to show a timestamp, footer content, and optional delivery status. Non-rendering scalar slots (booleans and empty strings) create no separator; numeric zero remains visible. Composite React content remains caller-owned.

entries.name: ChatSendButton
entries.title: Chat Send Button
entries.description: Use ChatSendButton as ChatComposer’s send control when the action should switch between sending and stopping. Inside ChatComposer it reads readiness, streaming state, and action callbacks from context; standalone usage supplies those values explicitly.

entries.name: ChatSystemMessage
entries.title: Chat System Message
entries.description: Use ChatSystemMessage for concise, non-sender content inside a chat transcript. Choose the default variant for factual status notices and the divider variant for date or section breaks. Long default content wraps within the available width. It carries no live role: inside a ChatMessageList, the log announces new notic…

entries.name: ChatTokenizedText
entries.title: Chat Tokenized Text
entries.description: Use ChatTokenizedText inside a chat message when stored plain text contains serialized token values that should be projected as inline badges or caller-rendered token content. Unmatched text is preserved exactly and empty token values are ignored so rendering always finishes.

entries.name: ChatToolCalls
entries.title: Chat Tool Calls
entries.description: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response. Pass an array of calls and the component handles the rest: a single call renders inline, while multiple calls collapse into a summary with the latest call visible at the surface. Use it anywhere an AI agent shows what actions it took.

entries.name: CheckboxInput
entries.title: Checkbox Input
entries.description: CheckboxInput toggles a single on/off value. Use it for settings like "Enable notifications", terms acceptance, or opt-in choices. For multiple checkboxes in a group, use CheckboxList instead.

entries.name: CheckboxList
entries.title: Checkbox List
entries.description: CheckboxList shows a small group of checkboxes so users can turn several options on or off at once. Place it in settings pages, filter panels, or forms where every choice should be visible without scrolling. For a single standalone checkbox (like "I agree to the terms"), use CheckboxInput instead. If only one option c…

entries.name: CheckboxListItem
entries.title: Checkbox List Item
entries.description: Individual checkbox item with label, description, and end content slot. Works in collection mode (inside a CheckboxList with a value array) or standalone mode (inside List, or inside a CheckboxList without value, such as a select-all item). On a touch screen (a coarse primary pointer), a toggleable row is one press ta…

entries.name: Citation
entries.title: Citation
entries.description: Citations display inline references to external sources. Use them to attribute information within AI-generated responses, articles, or anywhere provenance and source links are needed.

entries.name: Code
entries.title: Code
entries.description: Code marks short inline references such as function names, variables, file paths, and command-line flags. Use CodeBlock for standalone or multi-line snippets.

entries.name: CodeBlock
entries.title: Code Block
entries.description: CodeBlock renders syntax-highlighted code with line numbers, a copy button, and optional collapsible sections. Use CodeBlock for multi-line snippets like source files, terminal commands, and configuration examples. Use Code for inline references to function names, variables, or CLI flags within body text.

entries.name: Collapsible
entries.title: Collapsible
entries.description: Collapsible hides and reveals content behind a trigger button. Use it in settings panels, FAQ pages, or detail views to keep the page scannable while letting users drill into sections they care about. Wrap multiple collapsibles in CollapsibleGroup for accordion behavior. For custom collapsible components, use the `use…

entries.name: CollapsibleGroup
entries.title: Collapsible Group
entries.description: Coordinates multiple Collapsible instances so only one (single mode) or any number (multiple mode) can be open at a time. Renders no wrapper DOM element unless dividers are enabled.

entries.name: CommandPalette
entries.title: Command Palette
entries.description: CommandPalette is a searchable dialog for quick access to commands, navigation, and actions. Use it as a keyboard-driven launcher powered by SearchSource for filtering and selection.

entries.name: CommandPaletteEmpty
entries.title: Command Palette Empty
entries.description: Empty state display for the results area. CommandPalette renders it automatically when a search returns no results, or when there is no query and bootstrap() returns nothing.

entries.name: CommandPaletteFooter
entries.title: Command Palette Footer
entries.description: CommandPalette renders CommandPaletteFooter automatically. Pass a CommandPaletteFooter to the footer slot only when replacing the default guidance.

entries.name: CommandPaletteGroup
entries.title: Command Palette Group
entries.description: Visual grouping with a heading label. Place inside CommandPaletteList.

entries.name: CommandPaletteInput
entries.title: Command Palette Input
entries.description: Use CommandPaletteInput inside CommandPalette for a popup-backed command query, or as an independent search field when no result popup is present.

entries.name: CommandPaletteItem
entries.title: Command Palette Item
entries.description: Use CommandPaletteItem for one non-interactive result row inside CommandPaletteList or CommandPaletteGroup. CommandPalette owns the composite keyboard model; standalone items expose only their explicit visual state and pointer activation.

entries.name: CommandPaletteList
entries.title: Command Palette List
entries.description: Scrollable results container. Renders as a listbox standalone, and inside CommandPalette while selectable results exist. Contains CommandPaletteItem and CommandPaletteGroup children.

entries.name: ContextMenu
entries.title: Context Menu
entries.description: A right-click context menu that appears at the cursor position. Use to provide contextual actions for specific elements or regions without cluttering the UI with visible buttons.

entries.name: DateInput
entries.title: Date Input
entries.description: DateInput lets the user type or pick a date from a calendar popover. Use it for scheduling, deadlines, booking dates, or any form field that needs a specific calendar date.

entries.name: DateRangeInput
entries.title: Date Range Input
entries.description: DateRangeInput lets users select a start and end date from a dual-month calendar popover. Use it for filtering data by time period, report generation, analytics dashboards, and booking flows.

entries.name: DateTimeInput
entries.title: Date Time Input
entries.description: DateTimeInput combines date and time selection in one field. With presentation="adaptive-native" (the default), mouse/trackpad devices use Astryx typed fields and popovers, while coarse-pointer devices use browser/OS date and time controls in the same two-segment field. presentation="native" uses both native controls…

entries.name: AlertDialog
entries.title: Alert Dialog
entries.description: AlertDialog asks the user to confirm a destructive or irreversible action before it happens. Use it for things like deleting content, revoking access, or discarding unsaved changes. It implements the WAI-ARIA APG [Alert Dialog pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alertdialog/): `role="alertdialog"`, a tit…

entries.name: Dialog
entries.title: Dialog
entries.description: Dialog displays a modal overlay that blocks interaction with the page until the user responds. Use it for delete confirmations, edit forms, terms acceptance, or any decision that should not be skipped. For cases where you want to show a dialog without managing open state, use the `useImperativeDialog` hook: call `dial…

entries.name: DialogHeader
entries.title: Dialog Header
entries.description: Use DialogHeader to give a dialog a labelled title area and optional close control.

entries.name: Divider
entries.title: Divider
entries.description: A visual separator that divides content into distinct sections. Use to create clear boundaries between groups of related content, or to demarcate interactive regions within a layout.

entries.name: Drawer
entries.title: Drawer
entries.description: A side panel that floats above page content for inspectors and detail views: the "click a table row, see its details" pattern. Unlike a docked panel it overlays the layout instead of reflowing it. Works on desktop and touch: the width budget applies on desktop and the panel preserves a 56px page reveal below 640px wit…

entries.name: DrawerHeader
entries.title: Drawer Header
entries.description: Compose DrawerHeader in the header slot of a Layout inside the Drawer, as DialogHeader is composed in Dialog, for a title row and, when you pass onOpenChange, a close button. The Layout keeps the header on the drawer inset instead of padding it twice. Drawer renders no close button of its own. Unlike DialogHeader it d…

entries.name: DropdownMenu
entries.title: Dropdown Menu
entries.description: A dropdown menu that displays a list of actionable items in a popup triggered by a button. Use to present action options as a next step in a process, or to offer contextual actions without cluttering the interface. Like the menus of macOS and iOS, the row under the pointer when it is released is the row that acts, the…

entries.name: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
entries.title: Dropdown Menu Checkbox Item
entries.description: An independently checkable option inside DropdownMenu. The row owns menuitemcheckbox semantics while the shared Indicator supplies decorative checkbox paint.

entries.name: DropdownMenuDivider
entries.title: Dropdown Menu Divider
entries.description: A horizontal rule separating groups of rows in a compound menu. Renders role="separator", so it is never a stop in the arrow-key order. The data-driven equivalent is the `{type: "divider"}` entry in `items`; both modes render this component, so they look and theme identically. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, dat…

entries.name: DropdownMenuGroup
entries.title: Dropdown Menu Group
entries.description: Use DropdownMenuGroup to give related compound-menu rows one visible and programmatic name. Use an untitled group only when a separate name would not help people understand the rows.

entries.name: DropdownMenuItem
entries.title: Dropdown Menu Item
entries.description: Use DropdownMenuItem inside DropdownMenu compound mode for one action or destination. Keep label, description, icon, and endContent non-interactive; controls belong in separate rows or the menu header/footer.

entries.name: DropdownMenuRadioGroup
entries.title: Dropdown Menu Radio Group
entries.description: Use DropdownMenuRadioGroup inside compound-mode DropdownMenu when several commands represent one mutually exclusive choice. Keep value in caller state, provide a concise accessible label, and render each choice as DropdownMenuRadioItem.

entries.name: DropdownMenuRadioItem
entries.title: Dropdown Menu Radio Item
entries.description: A single option in a DropdownMenuRadioGroup (role="menuitemradio"). Must be used inside a DropdownMenuRadioGroup.

entries.name: DropdownMenuSubMenu
entries.title: Dropdown Menu Submenu
entries.description: A single menu row that reveals a nested flyout of its own items. The row adopts DropdownMenuItem semantics (label / icon / description / isDisabled); its children become the flyout content. Opens inline-end with viewport auto-flip; Right/Enter/Space opens and focuses the first item, Left/Escape closes and returns focu…

entries.name: EmptyState
entries.title: Empty State
entries.description: EmptyState shows a placeholder when a content area has no data. Use it for empty lists, zero search results, first-time setups, or cleared inboxes. Always include a title and a next step so the user is not stuck.

entries.name: Field
entries.title: Field
entries.description: Field is a low-level wrapper for custom, native, or third-party controls that do not already provide field label, description, and status UI. Use it when you need the Field shell around a control you own; use styled Astryx inputs like TextInput, Typeahead, and Select directly when they already expose label, descriptio…

entries.name: FieldLabel
entries.title: Field Label
entries.description: Standalone label group for one control or a caller-labelled group, with optional supporting text, optionality indicators, icon, and tooltip.

entries.name: FieldStatus
entries.title: Field Status
entries.description: FieldStatus renders validation feedback for fields and field-like controls. Use it directly for custom controls that need the same error, warning, or success presentation as Field.

entries.name: InputGroup
entries.title: Input Group
entries.description: InputGroup connects an input with prefix/suffix addons in a single visual unit. Use it for URL fields, currency inputs, search fields with action buttons, or any input that needs contextual decorations.

entries.name: InputGroupText
entries.title: Input Group Text
entries.description: Use InputGroupText inside InputGroup for a short fixed prefix or suffix, such as a currency symbol, a protocol, or a unit, or for a decorative icon. It is plain text, not a control, and it is not part of the input's accessible name.

entries.name: FileInput
entries.title: File Input
entries.description: FileInput provides file upload with optional drag-and-drop support. Use it for single or multiple file selection with built-in validation for file type, size, and count. Pair with validation status for upload feedback.

entries.name: Heading
entries.title: Heading
entries.description: Semantic heading component that renders h1-h6 elements with themed styling, themed sizing via type scale tokens, and line-clamp truncation.

entries.name: HoverCard
entries.title: Hover Card
entries.description: HoverCard shows additional information when the user hovers or focuses a trigger element. Use it for profile cards, link summaries, or inline definitions where the user needs more context without navigating away.

entries.name: Icon
entries.title: Icon
entries.description: Icons are small visual symbols that represent actions, objects, or concepts. They improve scannability and reinforce meaning alongside text. Supports both direct SVG components and semantic icon names that adapt to the active theme.

entries.name: InfoTip
entries.title: Info Tip
entries.description: An info icon that reveals help: a small "i" button. Hover and keyboard focus preview the help, and a click, tap, Enter, or Space pins it open until Escape, a second press, a press outside, or focus leaving. Use it next to labels, values, and metrics for permission notes, metric definitions, and field help. Its value o…

entries.name: Item
entries.title: Item
entries.description: A single, flexible item primitive that unifies the "start content + label + description + end content" pattern across Astryx. Use it wherever you need a structured row: dropdown menus, selectors, contact lists, notifications, file browsers, and activity feeds.

entries.name: Kbd
entries.title: Kbd
entries.description: Renders a keyboard shortcut as styled key badges. Use Kbd in tooltips, menus, and help text to show key combinations.

entries.name: Center
entries.title: Center
entries.description: Center aligns content to the middle of its container. Use it for empty states, loading screens, login forms, or any content that should sit in the center of the available space.

entries.name: FormLayout
entries.title: Form Layout
entries.description: A layout container that arranges form fields with consistent spacing and direction. FormLayout handles where fields go, not state or submission. Wrap it in a native <form> for that; <form> has no Astryx replacement, so it stays a plain element. Supports vertical (default), horizontal, and horizontal-labels directions,…

entries.name: Grid
entries.title: Grid
entries.description: A CSS grid layout container for arranging children in rows and columns. Use Grid for card galleries, dashboards, and any multi-column layout. For columns that reflow on small screens, use `columns={{minWidth, max}}`; a numeric `columns` is exactly N columns at every width and never reflows.

entries.name: GridSpan
entries.title: Grid Span
entries.description: Grid item that spans multiple columns or rows.

entries.name: HStack
entries.title: HStack
entries.description: Horizontal stack that arranges items along the inline axis: left to right in LTR, right to left in RTL. Supports polymorphic rendering.

entries.name: Layout
entries.title: Layout
entries.description: Layout is a general five-slot primitive for arranging header, start, content, end, and footer regions within a page or bounded container. AppShell owns the page shell and app-wide navigation behavior; use HStack or VStack for simple directional stacking.

entries.name: LayoutContent
entries.title: Layout Content
entries.description: Scrollable main content area.

entries.name: LayoutFooter
entries.title: Layout Footer
entries.description: Bottom bar for action bars, pagination, and status bars.

entries.name: LayoutHeader
entries.title: Layout Header
entries.description: Top bar for page titles, app bars, and toolbars.

entries.name: LayoutPanel
entries.title: Layout Panel
entries.description: Sidebar for navigation, settings, or inspector panels.

entries.name: Section
entries.title: Section
entries.description: Section is the correct way to create page regions and group related content on a page. Use it for settings groups, form sections, sidebar areas, or any time you need visual separation between parts of a page. If you are tempted to use a Card for a page section, use Section instead.

entries.name: Stack
entries.title: Stack
entries.description: Stack arranges items in a row or column with consistent spacing. Use the gap prop to control the space between items.

entries.name: VStack
entries.title: VStack
entries.description: Vertical stack for arranging items top-to-bottom. Supports polymorphic rendering.

entries.name: Lightbox
entries.title: Lightbox
entries.description: A fullscreen overlay for viewing images and videos at full resolution. Supports single-item and gallery modes with prev/next navigation and swiping, optional zoom and pan for images, and native video controls.

entries.name: Link
entries.title: Link
entries.description: A styled anchor for inline and standalone text navigation. Supports external links, underline variants, tooltips, and custom link components for router integration. Use it for navigating between pages or to external URLs.

entries.name: List
entries.title: List
entries.description: A vertical collection of items with consistent spacing, dividers, and optional markers. Supports headers, icons, avatars, badges, and interactive items with click or link behavior. Use it to display ordered or unordered groups of related content.

entries.name: ListItem
entries.title: List Item
entries.description: List item with label, description, start/end content slots, and interactive patterns.

entries.name: Markdown
entries.title: Markdown
entries.description: Renders a markdown string as Astryx-styled components. Use Markdown for user-generated content, AI responses, and documentation; it handles headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citations with consistent styling.

entries.name: MetadataList
entries.title: Metadata List
entries.description: MetadataList displays key-value pairs for object attributes like quality, condition, and status, in a structured layout. Use it for detail panels, settings summaries, and record information.

entries.name: MetadataListItem
entries.title: Metadata List Item
entries.description: A single labeled metadata value within an MetadataList.

entries.name: MoreMenu
entries.title: More Menu
entries.description: MoreMenu is a three-dot button that opens a list of actions. Use it for secondary actions that don't need to be always visible, like in table rows, card headers, or toolbars. Host `data-*` attributes reach the trigger button; its accessible name, `id`, and menu disclosure attributes stay component-owned.

entries.name: MobileNav
entries.title: Mobile Nav
entries.description: A slide-out drawer for mobile navigation. MobileNav is the mobile counterpart to SideNav and accepts the same children. Use it on narrow viewports where a persistent sidebar is not practical. Inside AppShell, use MobileNavToggle as the trigger; it reads state from context automatically.

entries.name: NavIcon
entries.title: Nav Icon
entries.description: NavIcon is a circular icon container with an accent-colored background. Use it in navigation headers such as TopNavHeading and PageNavHeader to visually identify a section or application.

entries.name: SideNav
entries.title: Side Nav
entries.description: A sidebar navigation component for organizing application pages with sections, nested items, and icons. Use SideNav as the primary navigation when an app has 5 or more destinations or requires hierarchical grouping.

entries.name: SideNavCollapseButton
entries.title: Side Nav Collapse Button
entries.description: Toggle button for sidenav collapse. Place inside SideNav (reads context automatically) or outside it (hand the same controlled collapsible config to both). Renders as an icon-only ghost button by default.

entries.name: SideNavHeading
entries.title: Side Nav Heading
entries.description: Product/suite/account heading with smart interaction boundary logic for links and a menu popover.

entries.name: SideNavItem
entries.title: Side Nav Item
entries.description: Navigation item with icon, selected state, optional end content, and nesting support via children.

entries.name: SideNavSection
entries.title: Side Nav Section
entries.description: Section grouping with an optional title, subtitle, and end content.

entries.name: TopNav
entries.title: Top Nav
entries.description: TopNav is a horizontal navigation bar for product-level navigation in application headers. Use TopNav for 5 or fewer always-visible navigation items, or minimal navigation paired with search and controls. For complex navigation hierarchies, use a sidebar; to filter content, use tabs or filter buttons instead.

entries.name: TopNavHeading
entries.title: Top Nav Heading
entries.description: Product/suite/account heading for the TopNav heading slot. Supports smart interaction boundary logic: logo, heading text, superheading/subheading with independent links, and an optional menu popover with automatic chevron indicator.

entries.name: TopNavItem
entries.title: Top Nav Item
entries.description: Navigation link item for use in TopNav startContent: renders as an anchor with hover and selected states.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenu
entries.title: Top Nav Mega Menu
entries.description: Navigation item that displays a full-width mega menu panel on hover. Uses a slots API with items and featured props. TopNavMegaMenuItem renders itself in both desktop and mobile drawer modes. Supports inline collapsible drawer via render mode context.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard
entries.title: Top Nav Mega Menu Featured Card
entries.description: Standard featured card for the TopNavMegaMenu featured slot. Provides a consistent card with optional image, title, description, and CTA link.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuItem
entries.title: Top Nav Mega Menu Item
entries.description: An individual item inside an TopNavMegaMenu. Renders itself in both desktop (popover grid) and mobile drawer modes via render mode context.

entries.name: TopNavMenu
entries.title: Top Nav Menu
entries.description: Navigation item that displays a hover-triggered popover menu with rich items containing an icon, title, and optional description.

entries.name: NumberInput
entries.title: Number Input
entries.description: A form input for numeric values with built-in validation, min/max constraints, and step controls. Use NumberInput for quantities, measurements, percentages, and similar inputs.

entries.name: Outline
entries.title: Outline
entries.description: A table-of-contents sidebar for documentation pages, help centers, wikis, and long settings pages. Use it for navigation within a single page, not for app routes. Features a sliding indicator track that animates to the active heading. Each link is in the normal Tab order, and Enter/Space activate.

entries.name: OverflowList
entries.title: Overflow List
entries.description: A horizontal list that automatically hides items when they exceed the available width. Use OverflowList for breadcrumbs, toolbars, tag lists, or any row that needs to collapse gracefully at smaller sizes.

entries.name: Overlay
entries.title: Overlay
entries.description: Overlay layers action or supporting content over media, cards, video, or other bounded surfaces with an optional scrim and reveal behavior. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the root element.

entries.name: Pagination
entries.title: Pagination
entries.description: Pagination lets users step through pages of content. Place it below a table, list, or card grid so users can move forward and backward through results. Pick a variant to match the context: numbered pages for data tables, a count for large lists, compact for tight spaces, or dots for carousels.

entries.name: Popover
entries.title: Popover
entries.description: A click-triggered overlay anchored to a button or trigger element. entries.name: PowerSearch
entries.title: Power Search

Use it for complex multi-dimensional filtering when users need to combine multiple search criteria. For simple single-field search, use a text input instead. Host `data-*` attributes, `data-testid` included, reach the prim…

entries.name: ProgressBar
entries.title: Progress Bar
entries.description: A horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a task. Use it for operations where the duration is known, or as an animated indicator when progress can't be calculated. entries.name: RadioList
entries.title: Radio List
entries.description: A group of options where only one can be selected at a time. All options are visible at once, making it easy to compare choices. Use it when users need to pick one option from a small set.

entries.name: ScrollableArea
entries.title: Scrollable Area
entries.description: Provides a native scroll viewport and a real observed content box. The viewport enters the tab order only while a requested logical axis is effectively scrollable, and containment applies only to effective axes.

entries.name: SegmentedControl
entries.title: Segmented Control
entries.description: A segmented button group that allows users to make a single selection from a small set of mutually exclusive options. entries.name: SegmentedControlItem
entries.title: Segmented Control Item
entries.description: Individual segment item rendering as a radio button within the segmented control.

entries.name: ComplexSelector
entries.title: Complex Selector
entries.description: Use ComplexSelector when a selection needs richer custom content than a Selector option row. entries.name: MultiSelector
entries.title: Multi Selector
entries.description: A checkbox dropdown for selecting multiple values from a list. Selected items can display as a count, labels, or badges. Use it for filtering or when presenting a finite set of options where multiple choices are needed.

entries.name: Selector
entries.title: Selector
entries.description: A dropdown selector for choosing a single value from a list of options. Supports labels, validation, descriptions, and required/optional states. entries.name: SelectorOption
entries.title: Selector Option
entries.description: Helper component for custom item rendering inside an Selector renderOption prop.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.title: Skeleton
entries.description: An animated shimmer placeholder that previews the shape of content while it loads. Use it to build loading screens that match the layout of the real content. For content with unknown dimensions, use Spinner instead.

entries.name: Slider
entries.title: Slider
entries.description: A draggable control for selecting a numeric value or range within defined bounds. Supports single value and range selection, tick marks, custom value formatting, and vertical orientation. Use it when users need to explore a continuous range, such as volume, price, or percentage. entries.name: Spinner
entries.title: Spinner
entries.description: An animated loading indicator for processes with unknown duration, such as data fetching or form submission. Supports visible labels, multiple sizes, and a dark background variant. For content with known dimensions, use Skeleton instead.

entries.name: StatusDot
entries.title: Status Dot
entries.description: A small colored dot that communicates status like online/offline presence or severity levels. Supports five semantic variants and an optional pulse animation. Always pair with a visible text label, as color alone should not carry meaning.

entries.name: Step
entries.title: Step
entries.description: Individual step within a Stepper. Renders a progress-bar segment, an indicator, and a label with optional description. Progress (completed/active/not-started) is derived from the parent Stepper's activeStep and this step's step index.

entries.name: Stepper
entries.title: Stepper
entries.description: Steppers display progress through a sequence of logical and numbered steps. Use them for multi-step workflows like forms, onboarding flows, or checkout processes where users need to see their position and the steps ahead. Rendered as an ordered list (not a navigation landmark).

entries.name: Switch
entries.title: Switch
entries.description: A toggle control for on/off states that take effect immediately. Supports labels, descriptions, loading states, and validation. entries.title: Table
entries.description: Table displays structured data in rows and columns with consistent dimensionality. entries.title: Table Header Cell

entries.title: Table Row

entries.title: Table Selection Toolbar

entries.name: Tab
entries.title: Tab
entries.description: Individual tab item that renders as a button or an anchor link, with selected-state styling and optional icons.

entries.name: TabList
entries.title: Tab List
entries.description: TabList provides tab-style navigation for organizing content into categorized sections. Use it to let users switch between related views without leaving the page. A strip narrower than its tabs scrolls horizontally and keeps the selected tab in view.

entries.name: TabMenu
entries.title: Tab Menu
entries.description: Overflow menu trigger that opens a dropdown of additional tab options, showing the selected option's label as the trigger text. entries.name: Text
entries.title: Text
entries.description: Text renders styled body text and headings from the theme. Use Text with a semantic type for body copy, labels, and captions, and Heading for section titles that output the correct h1–h6 element.

entries.name: TextArea
entries.title: Text Area
entries.description: TextArea is a multi-line text input for collecting longer-form content like comments, descriptions, or messages. Use it when the expected input spans multiple lines. For shorter, single-line values, use TextInput.

entries.name: TextInput
entries.title: Text Input
entries.description: TextInput collects short-form text like names, emails, or search queries. Use it for single-line values where the expected input is brief. Pair it with validation status to guide users through required or formatted fields.

entries.name: Thumbnail
entries.title: Thumbnail
entries.description: Thumbnail displays a compact, square preview of an image attachment. It shows a shimmer effect while uploading, the image on success, and a placeholder icon when no source is set. Use it in chat composers, file upload lists, or anywhere you need a small image preview with optional remove and click actions.

entries.name: TimeInput
entries.title: Time Input
entries.description: TimeInput uses a browser/OS time picker on coarse pointers by default and Astryx's typed field on fine pointers. It converts values to a standard format and supports arrow-key adjustment on the typed surface. Use it in forms, scheduling flows, or any interface where users need to select a specific time.

entries.name: Timer
entries.title: Timer
entries.description: Displays a standardized elapsed duration for active work without scheduling a React render on every tick. Elapsed format updates by second below one hour and by minute after one hour; clock format remains second-precise.

entries.name: Timestamp
entries.title: Timestamp
entries.description: Timestamp formats a date or time value into human-readable text. Use it to show when something was created, updated, or is scheduled; picking relative for recency, absolute for precision, or auto to let the component decide.

entries.name: Toast
entries.title: Toast
entries.description: Toast shows a brief, non-blocking notification to confirm an action or present temporary information. Use it for scenarios where the user needs feedback but not a decision, such as saving, deleting, or changing a status. For production use, prefer the `useToast()` hook; it handles positioning, stacking, auto-dismiss,…

entries.name: Token
entries.title: Token
entries.description: Token is a small, inline element for representing discrete pieces of associated data, like tags, categories, or selections. Use it to label content, show active filters, or represent removable items like selected recipients in a compose field.

entries.name: Tokenizer
entries.title: Tokenizer
entries.description: Tokenizer is a multi-select input that lets users search, select, and manage multiple items displayed as removable chips. Use it when users need to build a set of selections from a searchable data source, like adding team members, applying tags, or choosing filters.

entries.name: Toolbar
entries.title: Toolbar
entries.description: Toolbar is a horizontal bar with left, center, and right areas. Use it for contextual actions within a content area (above a table, inside a card, or in a panel), not as a page-level header. Set the size once on the toolbar and all buttons, inputs, and tabs inside it match automatically.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.title: Tooltip
entries.description: A short text hint that appears on hover or focus, anchored to a trigger element. Use it to describe icon-only buttons, show the full text of truncated labels, or provide supplementary context without cluttering the UI.

entries.name: TreeList
entries.title: Tree List
entries.description: An expandable tree structure for displaying hierarchical data with branch connector lines. Use it for file explorers, nested category browsers, or any interface that visualizes parent-child relationships. entries.name: BaseTypeahead
entries.title: Base Typeahead
entries.description: Composable combobox engine providing a bare input, search, keyboard navigation, and a styled result dropdown. It renders no input wrapper, border, or selected-value token. Typeahead and Tokenizer compose it for standard fields.

entries.name: Typeahead
entries.title: Typeahead
entries.description: A searchable input for selecting a single item from a large or dynamic dataset. Results appear as the user types, with support for async data sources, debounced search, and custom item rendering. Use it when the option list is too large for a Selector dropdown.

entries.name: TypeaheadItem
entries.title: Typeahead Item
entries.description: Default dropdown item renderer for typeahead results. Shows label with optional icon, description, and avatar. Exported for use in custom renderItem implementations.

entries.name: InternationalizationProvider
entries.title: Internationalization Provider
entries.description: Wraps your app to set the active locale and (optionally) merge additional translation catalogs + per-locale overrides. Astryx components inside the subtree resolve their strings against this context. If no provider is present, components fall back to the shipped English defaults.

entries.name: LinkProvider
entries.title: Link Provider
entries.description: Wraps your app to replace the default <a> tag with a framework-specific link component (e.g. Next.js Link) for client-side routing across all Astryx components.

entries.title: useToast

entries.name: useTooltip
entries.title: useTooltip

entries.title: useAppShellMobile

entries.title: useScrollableArea

keywords: use heading for document headings and text for everything else; they apply the full type scale automatically.
adjust typography holistically: change base and ratio in definetheme to shift the entire ramp (e.g. { base: 16, ratio: 1.25 } for editorial, { base: 12, ratio: 1.125 } for dense ui).

use display types with as="h1" (or h2/h3) when display text is a page heading; this preserves accessibility while giving you display-level sizing. or better, use `<heading level={1} type="display-1">` which handles both semantics and styling.
let line-height snap to the 4px grid via the type scale; expandtypescale computes leading automatically from base and ratio.
use the supporting type for secondary information: timestamps, helper text, metadata, captions.
use accessibilitylevel on heading when the visual hierarchy doesn't match the document outline (e.g. sidebar or card headings).
set font-size or line-height manually; use the semantic type scale tokens so the full ramp stays consistent and 4px-grid-aligned.
skip heading levels (e.g. h1 to h3); screen readers rely on an unbroken hierarchy. use accessibilitylevel to decouple visual from semantic level.
use display types for body content or in-page sections; they're designed for hero/marketing/data-callout contexts only.
override individual size tokens (--font-size-lg) to "tweak" a heading; adjust base/ratio instead so proportions remain coherent across the entire scale.
use raw numeric font-weight values (400, 600); reference the semantic weight tokens so themes can remap them.
