entries.title: AvatarGroupOverflow — Default Count
entries.description: Use AvatarGroupOverflow without children to render the standard +N overflow count.

entries.name: AvatarStatusDotShowcase
entries.title: AvatarStatusDot
entries.description: AvatarStatusDot renders a presence indicator on an Avatar, with variants for positive, neutral, and negative states. The dot size automatically coordinates with the Avatar size.

entries.name: AvatarStatusDotVariants
entries.title: AvatarStatusDot — Variants
entries.description: Presence dots on Avatars using the success, neutral, and error variants. Pass an AvatarStatusDot to the Avatar status prop; the dot sizes itself to match the Avatar.

entries.name: BadgeCategoryTags
entries.title: Badge — Colors
entries.description: Tag items with color-coded categories like teams, priorities, or topics. Use the 9 non-semantic color variants when you need to distinguish groups visually.

entries.name: BadgeCountBadges
entries.title: Badge — Counts
entries.description: Show a number inside a badge for notification counts, unread messages, or task totals. Use next to icons, nav items, or list labels.

entries.name: BadgeStatusLabels
entries.title: Badge — Status
entries.description: Show the state of an item like Active, Pending, or Failed. Use in table rows, list items, or detail pages where users need to see status at a glance.

entries.name: BadgeShowcase
entries.title: Badge — Variants
entries.description: All semantic and color badge variants in a single view. Use semantic variants for status and color variants for categories.

entries.name: BannerWithActionButton
entries.title: Banner — Action
entries.description: Add a button to a banner so the user can act on the message. Use for trial expirations, payment failures, or anything that needs a response.

entries.name: BannerCollapsibleContent
entries.title: Banner — Collapsible
entries.description: Combine an action button, dismiss control, and a collapsible detail area in one banner. Children sit behind the toggle by default; `collapsible={{defaultIsOpen: true}}` starts it open, and `collapsible={false}` drops the toggle entirely. Use for complex notifications like config changes or deployment summaries.

entries.name: BannerDismissable
entries.title: Banner — Dismiss
entries.description: Let the user close a banner after reading it. Use for maintenance notices, feature tips, or any non-critical message the user can acknowledge.

entries.name: BannerFloating
entries.title: Banner — Floating
entries.description: A floating banner raised with `elevation="med"`. Banners are inline by default; raise one when it should read as an overlay above content.

entries.name: BannerSectionVariant
entries.title: Banner — Full Width
entries.description: A full-width banner with no border radius for page-level notifications. Use at the top of a page for site-wide announcements or maintenance alerts.

entries.name: BannerShowcase
entries.title: Banner — Statuses
entries.description: All four status banners stacked: info, success, warning, and error. A quick visual reference for choosing the right status.

entries.name: BannerStatuses
entries.title: Banner — Statuses
entries.description: All 4 banner statuses: info, success, warning, and error. Use to show persistent messages like updates, confirmations, cautions, or problems at the top of a page or section.

entries.name: BaseTypeaheadShowcase
entries.title: BaseTypeahead
entries.description: A custom result renderer that adds supporting metadata while BaseTypeahead retains option semantics and keyboard behavior.

entries.name: BaseTypeaheadCustomSearch
entries.title: BaseTypeahead — Custom Search Bar
entries.description: BaseTypeahead embedded inside a custom-styled wrapper. The wrapper provides its own border and icon chrome; anchorRef positions the dropdown relative to it. Use this pattern when Typeahead's built-in field layout does not fit your composition.

entries.name: BaseTypeaheadMenu
entries.title: BaseTypeahead — Menu
entries.description: A filter field built on BaseTypeahead's `menu`. The listbox role puts a heading and a key hint around the result list, and keeps every action a result. Picking a field switches the same menu to a dialog role that edits the value; `handleRef.open()` reopens it from a filter button, and Escape returns focus to that butt…

entries.name: DrawerShowcase
entries.title: Basic
entries.description: Open a modal drawer from a single trigger. The scrim dims the page; Escape, a scrim click, or the header close button closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.

entries.name: login
entries.title: Basic Login
entries.description: Minimal centered credential form on a plain ground: two fields and a submit, nothing competing for attention. The least-chrome entry surface.

entries.name: blank
entries.title: Blank
entries.description: Bare scaffold: one heading slot, one empty content region, no navigation and no chrome. The starting point when every other layout imposes more structure than wanted.

entries.name: BlockquoteShowcase
entries.title: Blockquote — Showcase
entries.description: Blockquote with and without citation. A quick visual reference for the blockquote component.

entries.name: BlockquoteTestimonials
entries.title: Blockquote — Testimonials
entries.description: Multiple quotes arranged in a card grid for a testimonials section. Combine with Card and Grid to create social-proof layouts.

entries.name: BlockquoteWithCite
entries.title: Blockquote — With Attribution
entries.description: A plain quote and a quote with a cite attribution. Use cite to credit the original author or source.

entries.name: BottomSheetShowcase
entries.title: Bottom Sheet
entries.description: A mobile filter surface that rises from the bottom edge.

entries.name: BottomSheetHeights
entries.title: Bottom Sheet — Height variants
entries.description: Compares hug, capped, and tall starting heights for different amounts of content.

entries.name: BottomSheetMobileKeyboard
entries.title: Bottom Sheet — Mobile keyboard
entries.description: Uses a tall, scrollable form that keeps focused controls visible above the mobile keyboard.

entries.name: BottomSheetSwitcherShowcase
entries.title: Bottom Sheet — Multi-step flow
entries.description: A three-step flow of standalone sheets of different heights, driven by one state value: moving on replaces the open step in place. This is the replacement for the deprecated BottomSheetSwitcher.

entries.name: BottomSheetNoScrim
entries.title: Bottom Sheet — No scrim
entries.description: Keeps the page visible and interactive behind a non-modal bottom sheet.

entries.name: BottomSheetSwitcherReviewFlow
entries.title: Bottom Sheet — Review flow
entries.description: A two-step form flow of two standalone sheets driven by one state value: Continue replaces the review step with the confirmation in place, and Back returns.

entries.name: BottomSheetSnapPoints
entries.title: Bottom Sheet — Snap points
entries.description: Drag-to-resize stops: a half-height working surface, and a peek that slides away and thins the scrim.

entries.name: BreadcrumbItemShowcase
entries.title: BreadcrumbItem
entries.description: BreadcrumbItem represents a single step in a breadcrumb trail, supporting links, icons, current-page markers, and custom link components.

entries.name: BreadcrumbItemBasic
entries.title: BreadcrumbItem — Basic
entries.description: Breadcrumb links inside a Breadcrumbs trail. Ancestor pages get an href; mark the last item with isCurrent to render it as plain text for the current page.

entries.name: BreadcrumbsShowcase
entries.title: Breadcrumbs
entries.description: A breadcrumb trail showing page hierarchy with linked ancestors and a current page.

entries.name: BreadcrumbsDeepHierarchy
entries.title: Breadcrumbs — Deep Path
entries.description: A 5-level breadcrumb trail for deeply nested content. Use in e-commerce, file browsers, or any UI with several levels of hierarchy.

entries.name: BreadcrumbsWithIcons
entries.title: Breadcrumbs — Icons
entries.description: Add icons before breadcrumb labels for quick recognition. Use a home icon on the root item and contextual icons on key sections.

entries.name: BreadcrumbsMenuItem
entries.title: Breadcrumbs — Menu item
entries.description: Give a mid-trail crumb a `menu` prop to turn it into a menu trigger for switching between sibling destinations. It reuses the same item API as DropdownMenu, so an existing option array (or composed item children) drops in verbatim.

entries.name: BreadcrumbsCustomSeparator
entries.title: Breadcrumbs — Separators
entries.description: Swap the default "/" for a different character like chevrons, arrows, or dots. Use when the visual style of the page calls for a different separator.

entries.name: BreadcrumbsSupportingVariant
entries.title: Breadcrumbs — Variants
entries.description: Compare the default and supporting variants side by side. Use the supporting variant in dense UIs like admin panels where the breadcrumb should be subtle.

entries.name: ButtonWithEndSlot
entries.title: Button — End Slot
entries.description: Buttons with a trailing badge showing a count or status. Use for notification counts, unread messages, or any button that needs a visual indicator.

entries.name: ButtonFloating
entries.title: Button — Floating
entries.description: A floating action button raised with `elevation="med"`. Use elevation for buttons that hover above content, like a FAB.

entries.name: ButtonWithIcon
entries.title: Button — Icon
entries.description: Buttons with a leading icon that reinforces the label. Use when the icon helps the user identify the action faster, like a plus for "New" or a trash can for "Delete".

entries.name: ButtonSizeVariants
entries.title: Button — Sizes
entries.description: Small, medium, and large buttons side by side. Use small in dense UIs like toolbars, medium for most cases, and large for prominent CTAs.

entries.name: ButtonShowcase
entries.title: Button — Variants
entries.description: All four button variants side by side: primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive. A quick visual reference for choosing the right variant.

entries.name: ButtonVariants
entries.title: Button — Variants
entries.description: All 4 button variants in default, disabled, and loading states. Use primary for the main action, secondary for most others, ghost for low-emphasis, and destructive for dangerous actions.

entries.name: ButtonGroupBasic
entries.title: ButtonGroup — Basic
entries.description: Three related actions joined into a single connected control. Provide a group label for accessibility and keep all buttons the same variant so they read as one unit.

entries.name: ButtonGroupFloating
entries.title: ButtonGroup — Floating
entries.description: A grouped action bar raised with `elevation="med"`. The connected buttons share one surface, so the shadow lifts them as a unit.

entries.name: CalendarShowcase
entries.title: Calendar
entries.description: An interactive single-date calendar with a selected date. Click any day to change the selection.

entries.name: CalendarConstraints
entries.title: Calendar — Constraints
entries.description: Limit which dates can be selected using min/max bounds and custom rules like weekdays only. Use for scheduling UIs where certain dates are unavailable.

entries.name: CalendarRangeWithValue
entries.title: Calendar — Range
entries.description: Pick a start and end date with the range highlighted between them. Use for booking dates, time-off requests, or report filters.

entries.name: CalendarSingle
entries.title: Calendar — Single
entries.description: Pick one date from a month grid. Use for appointment dates, due dates, or any field that needs a single date.

entries.name: CalendarTwoMonths
entries.title: Calendar — Two Months
entries.description: Two months side by side for selecting ranges that span a month boundary. Use in booking or travel UIs where check-in and check-out often fall in different months.

entries.name: canvas-editor
entries.title: Canvas Editor
entries.description: Layered artboard workspace: document tabs over a layer rail, a fixed-size frame you zoom on a muted backdrop, and an inspector of position, type, and filter fields that retargets to the selected layer. Objects hold a coordinate rather than reflowing, so moving one never moves another.

entries.name: CardShowcase
entries.title: Card
entries.description: A card with a heading and body text showing the default container style.

entries.name: CardCallout
entries.title: Card — Callout
entries.description: Muted-variant cards for tips, notes, or supplementary information. Use when content should be visually distinct but not prominent. The muted variant uses a wash background instead of the elevated default, making it feel recessed rather than raised. Works well in sidebars, help panels, or inline callouts.

entries.name: CardElevations
entries.title: Card — Elevations
entries.description: The four elevation levels side by side. Cards are flat by default; raise a card with `elevation` only when it needs to float above surrounding content.

entries.name: CardWithInnerLayout
entries.title: Card — Layout
entries.description: A card with a structured header, content area, and footer with action buttons. Use for forms, dialogs, or settings panels that need clear sections. Pair Card with Layout to get automatic dividers between header, content, and footer. The footer aligns actions to the right by default.

entries.name: CardWithSimpleContent
entries.title: Card — Simple
entries.description: A card with a heading and body text. Use for summaries, descriptions, or any grouped content that needs visual separation from the page. The card handles its own border, background, and padding; just pass your content as children. Set a width to constrain it, or leave it to fill the parent.

entries.name: CardVariants
entries.title: Card — Variants
entries.description: Default, muted, and color variants side by side. Use color variants to categorize cards visually, like team colors, project tags, or content types. Each color uses the corresponding background token from the theme, so they adapt to light and dark mode automatically.

entries.name: library
entries.title: Card Grid
entries.description: Searchable, browsable card grid with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles organized by topic, narrowing in place, with no detail surface behind them.

entries.name: CarouselShowcase
entries.title: Carousel
entries.description: A horizontal carousel of cards with scroll-snap and navigation buttons. Scroll or click the arrows to browse.

entries.name: CarouselCards
entries.title: Carousel — Cards
entries.description: A horizontally scrollable row of cards with snap scrolling enabled. Use for feature grids, product lists, or any set of cards that overflows the available width. The carousel adds fade edges and navigation buttons automatically.

entries.name: CarouselSnap
entries.title: Carousel — Snap
entries.description: Scroll-snap carousel with navigation buttons and team member cards. Each card snaps to the start edge on scroll. Use when items should be viewed one at a time rather than as a continuous strip.

entries.name: CenterShowcase
entries.title: Center
entries.description: Content centered horizontally and vertically inside a fixed-height container.

entries.name: CenterHorizontal
entries.title: Center — Horizontal Center
entries.description: A formatting control group centered with axis="horizontal" in the default horizontal writing mode. In other writing modes, Center currently follows the flex main axis rather than guaranteeing physical horizontal centering.

entries.name: CenterInsideACard
entries.title: Center — Vertical & Horizontal Center
entries.description: An empty state with an icon, heading, and description centered both vertically and horizontally inside a card. This is the most common use of Center: placing content in the middle of a fixed-height area like a panel, card, or content region. The height prop defines the centering space.

entries.name: centered-hero
entries.title: Centered Hero
entries.description: Symmetrical centered stack (headline, short blurb, paired call-to-action buttons) resting on one wide full-bleed picture, with nothing on either flank competing.

entries.name: ChatComposerAttachments
entries.title: ChatComposer — Attachments
entries.description: Chat composer with removable file tokens in a collapsible drawer. Use when users can attach files or context to their message.

entries.name: ChatComposerFlat
entries.title: ChatComposer — Flat
entries.description: The composer is raised by default (`elevation="low"`). Set `elevation="none"` to flatten it; it then draws a border with the same rest / hover / focus treatment as a text input.

entries.name: ChatComposerFooterActions
entries.title: ChatComposer — Footer Actions
entries.description: Chat composer with dropdown menus for a model selector and settings in the footer, and a mic button in the send actions slot.

entries.name: ChatComposerFullFeatured
entries.title: ChatComposer — Full Featured
entries.description: Chat composer with all slots populated: collapsible attachment drawer, header actions, context progress bar, footer dropdown menus, and mic button. Shows the maximum composer configuration.

entries.name: ChatComposerSimple
entries.title: ChatComposer — Simple
entries.description: Minimal chat composer with a placeholder and submit handler. The simplest way to drop a message input into a page.

entries.name: ChatComposerStreaming
entries.title: ChatComposer — Streaming
entries.description: Chat composer with streaming state and a stop button. Use when the assistant is generating a response and the user can cancel.

entries.name: ChatComposerValidation
entries.title: ChatComposer — Validation
entries.description: Chat composer with error and warning status messages. Status can appear above or below the composer to surface validation or system feedback.

entries.name: ChatComposerDrawerShowcase
entries.title: ChatComposerDrawer
entries.description: Composer drawer with file tokens, a collapsible toggle, and header actions. Use as a starting point for any chat composer with attachments.

entries.name: ChatComposerDrawerAttachments
entries.title: ChatComposerDrawer — Attachments
entries.description: Drawer with two rows: a scrollable carousel of image thumbnails and a row of removable file tokens. Omit count to keep the drawer always expanded.

entries.name: ChatComposerDrawerCollapsible
entries.title: ChatComposerDrawer — Collapsible
entries.description: Drawer with many items and a collapse toggle. Pass count to enable the toggle; collapsed state shows a badge with the total count and a label.

entries.name: ChatComposerDrawerFeedback
entries.title: ChatComposerDrawer — Feedback
entries.description: Chat composer drawer with a feedback prompt and selectable lettered options. Use for user confirmation workflows that require explicit action before proceeding.

entries.name: ChatComposerDrawerWithProgress
entries.title: ChatComposerDrawer — With Progress
entries.description: Drawer paired with a context progress bar in the header. Show context window usage when attachments consume part of the available token budget.

entries.name: ChatComposerInputControlledInput
entries.title: ChatComposerInput — Controlled
entries.description: Controlled chat input with live value display. Use controlled mode when you need to read or transform the input value outside the composer.

entries.name: ChatComposerInputDisabled
entries.title: ChatComposerInput — Disabled
entries.description: Composer in a disabled state. Use when the input should be visible but not interactive, such as during streaming or when a prerequisite is unmet.

entries.name: ChatComposerInputMentionTrigger
entries.title: ChatComposerInput — Mentions
entries.description: Chat input with an @ trigger that opens a typeahead menu for mentioning users. Selected names appear as inline tokens.

entries.name: ChatComposerInputMultipleTriggers
entries.title: ChatComposerInput — Multiple Triggers
entries.description: Chat input with both @ mentions and / commands. Each trigger type renders tokens in a distinct color so users can tell them apart at a glance.

entries.name: ChatComposerInputSlashCommands
entries.title: ChatComposerInput — Slash Commands
entries.description: Chat input with a / trigger for command selection. Use for AI assistants or bots that support structured commands.

entries.name: ChatDictationButtonShowcase
entries.title: ChatDictationButton
entries.description: Interactive dictation button connected to the SpeechRecognition API via useChatDictation. Click the mic to dictate into the composer.

entries.name: ChatDictationButtonBasic
entries.title: ChatDictationButton — Basic
entries.description: A dictation button wired to useChatDictation and placed in the sendActions slot of a ChatComposer. Click the microphone to transcribe speech into the input.

entries.name: ChatDictationDictationInComposer
entries.title: ChatDictationButton — In Composer
entries.description: Dictation button placed in the sendActions slot of a chat composer. Shows the recommended integration point for voice input alongside the send button.

entries.name: ChatDictationSizes
entries.title: ChatDictationButton — Sizes
entries.description: Small and medium dictation buttons side by side. Use small in compact composer densities and medium for standard layouts.

entries.name: ChatDictationDictationStates
entries.title: ChatDictationButton — States
entries.description: Dictation button in idle, listening, and speaking states side by side. Shows the three visual phases of a voice input interaction.

entries.name: ChatLayoutPanelChat
entries.title: ChatLayout — Panel View
entries.description: Narrow sidebar chat in a constrained container that triggers compact density. Use for side panels, drawers, or embedded chat widgets where horizontal space is limited.

entries.name: ChatLayoutScrollButtonStates
entries.title: ChatLayoutScrollButton
entries.description: Scroll button in hidden, visible, and expanded (with label) states. The button fades in when the user scrolls up and expands when new messages arrive.

entries.name: ChatLayoutScrollButtonLabels
entries.title: ChatLayoutScrollButton — Labels
entries.description: Scroll button with different labels for context-specific notifications like new messages, unread replies, or a generic scroll prompt.

entries.name: ChatMessageShowcase
entries.title: ChatMessage
entries.description: A user multi-bubble group with delivery status and an assistant ghost response with avatar, name, timestamp, and model info.

entries.name: ChatMessageAvatarName
entries.title: ChatMessage — Avatar & Name
entries.description: Messages with avatars and sender names. Place the name on the bubble when using bubbles, or on the message wrapper for raw content.

entries.name: ChatMessageGhost
entries.title: ChatMessage — Ghost
entries.description: Ghost variant for messages without visible bubble boundaries. Keeps padding for alignment but renders a transparent background, useful for AI-style responses.

entries.name: ChatMessageMultiBubble
entries.title: ChatMessage — Multi-Bubble
entries.description: Grouped bubbles using the group prop for corner radius reduction. Use first, middle, and last to visually connect related bubbles from the same sender.

entries.name: ChatMessageBubbleShowcase
entries.title: ChatMessageBubble
entries.description: Grouped user bubbles with filled styling and a ghost-variant agent response, with timestamps and delivery status.

entries.name: ChatMessageBubbleCustomContent
entries.title: ChatMessageBubble — Custom Content
entries.description: Custom in-message content aligned to the bubble text column. An artifact card is wrapped in a ghost bubble with width="100%", so its left edge matches the bubble text and it spans the full message column instead of the default bubble width cap; the timestamp rides the bubble metadata slot.

entries.name: ChatMessageBubbleDensity
entries.title: ChatMessageBubble — Density
entries.description: Compact, balanced, and spacious density modes side by side. Density controls bubble padding, corner radius, and spacing between grouped bubbles.

entries.name: ChatMessageBubbleGrouping
entries.title: ChatMessageBubble — Grouping
entries.description: Multi-bubble messages using first, middle, and last group positions. Grouped bubbles tighten corner radius on the sender side for a continuous visual flow.

entries.name: ChatMessageBubbleMetadata
entries.title: ChatMessageBubble — Metadata
entries.description: Bubbles with name and metadata slots aligned to bubble padding. Put name on the first bubble and metadata on the last bubble in a message.

entries.name: ChatMessageBubbleVariants
entries.title: ChatMessageBubble — Variants
entries.description: Filled and ghost bubble variants for both user and assistant senders. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visual boundary.

entries.name: ChatMessageListShowcase
entries.title: ChatMessageList
entries.description: Basic AI chat conversation with user and assistant messages. The simplest way to render a message list with alternating sender bubbles, metadata, and a date divider.

entries.name: ChatMessageListDensity
entries.title: ChatMessageList — Density
entries.description: Side-by-side comparison of compact, balanced, and spacious densities. Use compact in sidebars or panels, balanced for most full-page chat, and spacious for long-form reading. Use gap when row spacing needs to differ from density.

entries.name: ChatMessageListFullFeatured
entries.title: ChatMessageList — Full Featured
entries.description: Conversation showcasing system messages, multi-bubble grouping, markdown, code blocks, and metadata. Combines date dividers, ghost bubbles, grouped messages, and rich content in a single example.

entries.name: ChatMessageMetadataShowcase
entries.title: ChatMessageMetadata
entries.description: Three-message conversation showcasing error status with retry, delivery status, and full footer actions with model label.

entries.name: ChatMessageMetadataFooter
entries.title: ChatMessageMetadata — Footer Actions
entries.description: Assistant message with footer actions: copy, retry, thumbs up/down, and model label. Use for AI responses that need feedback or utility controls.

entries.name: ChatMessageMetadataStatus
entries.title: ChatMessageMetadata — Status
entries.description: All 5 delivery statuses (sending, sent, delivered, read, and error), each with a timestamp. Use to show message delivery progress or surface failures.

entries.name: ChatMessageMetadataTimestamp
entries.title: ChatMessageMetadata — Timestamps
entries.description: Timestamp-only metadata on user and assistant messages. Supports absolute time and relative formats via Timestamp.

entries.name: ChatSendButtonShowcase
entries.title: ChatSendButton
entries.description: Ready, custom icon, and streaming states of the send button.

entries.name: ChatSendButtonCustomIcon
entries.title: ChatSendButton — Custom Icon
entries.description: Send buttons with custom icons via sendIcon and stopIcon props. Use to match the personality of the chat experience: a paper airplane for messaging, sparkles for AI generation, or a check mark for confirmation flows.

entries.name: ChatSendButtonInComposer
entries.title: ChatSendButton — In Composer
entries.description: Send button inside ChatComposer, where it reads state from context automatically. No wiring needed; the button enables when the input has content.

entries.name: ChatSendButtonStates
entries.title: ChatSendButton — States
entries.description: Disabled, ready, and streaming states at both sizes. The button automatically toggles between send (primary) and stop (secondary) based on streaming state.

entries.name: ChatSystemMessageShowcase
entries.title: ChatSystemMessage
entries.description: System messages for date dividers, status updates, and informational notices. Shows both default and divider variants in a realistic conversation flow.

entries.name: ChatSystemMessageWithIcon
entries.title: ChatSystemMessage — Icon
entries.description: System messages with a leading icon that reinforces the message type. Use icons to help users scan and identify message categories at a glance.

entries.name: ChatSystemMessageStatusUpdates
entries.title: ChatSystemMessage — Status Updates
entries.description: Realistic status messages in a conversation flow showing membership changes, timestamps, and resolution notices.

entries.name: ChatSystemMessageVariants
entries.title: ChatSystemMessage — Variants
entries.description: Default and divider variants side by side. Use default for inline status updates and divider for date separators or section breaks.

entries.name: ChatTokenizedTextBasic
entries.title: ChatTokenizedText — Basic
entries.description: A message with @mention tokens. Each matching pattern is replaced with its display name badge.

entries.name: ChatTokenizedTextColors
entries.title: ChatTokenizedText — Colors
entries.description: Tokens with different color variants to distinguish mentions, bugs, and features. Use variant colors to create a visual taxonomy: blue for people, red for bugs, green for features.

entries.name: ChatToolCallsInteractiveToolCalls
entries.title: ChatToolCalls — Expandable
entries.description: Tool calls with expandable result details showing diffs and command output in code blocks. Click a row to reveal its result.

entries.name: ChatToolCallsToolCallsWithNodes
entries.title: ChatToolCalls — Simple
entries.description: A single inline tool call above a collapsible multi-call group with diff stats. Shows both layouts side by side.

entries.name: ChatToolCallsStatuses
entries.title: ChatToolCalls — Statuses
entries.description: All four status states (pending, running, complete, and error) shown together in a single group.

entries.name: CheckboxInputShowcase
entries.title: CheckboxInput
entries.description: Interactive checkboxes showing checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states with descriptions.

entries.name: CheckboxInputIndeterminateState
entries.title: CheckboxInput — Indeterminate
entries.description: A "select all" checkbox that controls a group of options. When only some options are checked, it shows a dash instead of a checkmark. Clicking it checks or unchecks everything.

entries.name: CheckboxInputBasic
entries.title: CheckboxInput — States
entries.description: Checkboxes with labels and descriptions in checked, unchecked, and disabled states. Each checkbox controls a single on/off setting. Add a description to explain what the setting does.

entries.name: CheckboxInputStatusVariations
entries.title: CheckboxInput — Status
entries.description: Checkboxes with error, warning, and success validation messages. Use the status prop to show feedback after form validation: errors block submission, warnings inform, and success confirms.

entries.name: CheckboxListSelectAllPattern
entries.title: CheckboxList — Select All With Indeterminate
entries.description: A "select all" toggle at the top of a checkbox list that switches to an indeterminate dash when only some items are checked, useful for bulk actions like exporting documents or assigning permissions where users often want everything at once.

entries.name: CheckboxListWithEndContent
entries.title: CheckboxList — With End Content
entries.description: Badges in the trailing slot show contextual info, like a price or status, next to each option without cluttering the label, so users can compare choices at a glance.

entries.name: CheckboxListItemShowcase
entries.title: CheckboxListItem
entries.description: Checkbox list items with labels, descriptions, and different states including disabled.

entries.name: CheckboxListItemBasic
entries.title: CheckboxListItem — Basic
entries.description: Checkbox items with labels and descriptions inside a controlled CheckboxList. Use for multi-select option groups like notification preferences.

entries.name: payment-form
entries.title: Checkout Form
entries.description: Long sectioned form running beside a summary that stays visible while the fields scroll and recalculates as they change, ending on a terminal confirm of the total. Sections run contact, address, delivery choice, then card details.

entries.name: checkout-wizard
entries.title: Checkout Wizard
entries.description: Multi-step checkout, cart, order, and payment wizard with a running summary that recalculates as answers change. It adapts to its host width, renders the summary first on narrow surfaces, validates every forward path, and completes locally without sending payment.

entries.name: CitationInlineText
entries.title: Citation — Inline Text
entries.description: Citations embedded within a paragraph of text, showing how they flow inline with surrounding content.

entries.name: CitationShowcase
entries.title: Citation — Showcase
entries.description: All citation variants at a glance: label chips and numbered badges, with and without icons and links.

entries.name: CitationSourceList
entries.title: Citation — Source List
entries.description: A list of citation sources with icons, as you might show at the end of an AI-generated response or article footer.

entries.name: classic-gallery
entries.title: Classic Gallery
entries.description: Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place. Regular rhythm, unlike the variable-height masonry variant.

entries.name: ClickableCardShowcase
entries.title: ClickableCard
entries.description: A clickable card that navigates on click. Nested interactive elements work independently.

entries.name: ClickableCardElevated
entries.title: ClickableCard — Elevated
entries.description: A clickable card raised with `elevation="med"` so the shadow signals the whole surface is interactive.

entries.name: ClickableCardWithNestedButton
entries.title: ClickableCardWithNestedButton
entries.description: A product card that navigates on click but has an independent "Add to cart" button inside.

entries.name: CodeShowcase
entries.title: Code
entries.description: Inline code snippets inside a sentence showing how Code renders alongside body text.

entries.name: CodeBlockJSONConfig
entries.title: Code — Config
entries.description: A JSON configuration file with a title bar and line numbers. The title prop adds a filename label in the header so readers know which file the code belongs to.

entries.name: CodeVariousContent
entries.title: Code — Content Types
entries.description: Inline code used for variables, terminal commands, CSS properties, file paths, and keyboard shortcuts. Shows how Code adapts to different kinds of technical content.

entries.name: CodeBlockHighlightedLines
entries.title: Code — Highlighted
entries.description: TypeScript code with specific lines highlighted to draw attention to a key section. Use highlightLines to call out new or important code in tutorials and changelogs.

entries.name: CodeInlineInParagraph
entries.title: Code — Inline
entries.description: Inline code references mixed within a paragraph of body text. Use Code to mark up function names, hooks, or API terms so they stand out from surrounding prose.

entries.name: CodeBlockScrollableBlock
entries.title: Code — Scrollable
entries.description: A long code block with a max height that enables vertical scrolling. Use maxHeight to keep the block from dominating the page when displaying large files.

entries.name: CodeBlockBashCommand
entries.title: Code — Snippet
entries.description: Short terminal commands with no header: the copy button sits in its own column beside the code, so a one-line command reads as a single row and a long line ends before the button instead of running under it. Use for install instructions or one-liner commands that readers will paste directly.

entries.name: CodeBlockTerminal
entries.title: Code — Terminal
entries.description: A dark terminal-style command block: a bash CodeBlock wrapped in SyntaxTheme with the GitHub Dark preset, copy button on, and no line numbers. Use for shell sessions or CLI output that should read as a terminal even on light pages. Reach for a dark syntax preset instead of hand-rolling a dark box with custom CSS.

entries.name: CodeAcrossTextSizes
entries.title: Code — Text Sizes
entries.description: Inline code rendered inside heading, body, supporting, and label text. Code automatically matches the font size of its parent text element.

entries.name: CodeBlockShowcase
entries.title: CodeBlock
entries.description: A syntax-highlighted TypeScript code block with line numbers, a title bar, and a copy button.

entries.name: CollapsibleShowcase
entries.title: Collapsible
entries.description: An accordion group with three collapsible sections in single mode: opening one closes the others.

entries.name: CollapsibleControlledAccordion
entries.title: Collapsible — Controlled
entries.description: Manage the open section from parent state, so something other than a click can move it: a URL parameter, a form jumping to the step that failed validation, or the Previous/Next controls shown here. onChange hands back the whole open value.

entries.name: CollapsibleDividedAccordion
entries.title: Collapsible — FAQ
entries.description: FAQ built with hasDividers: row hairlines and density padding with no custom CSS. Questions set their own type — body at semibold, not the trigger's default 17px large — so a list of questions reads as rows rather than a stack of headings, and question and answer separate on weight and color instead of size.

entries.name: CollapsibleMultipleAccordion
entries.title: Collapsible — Multiple Mode
entries.description: Several sections open at once, for comparing across them — feature lists, pricing tiers. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its own large type: it is the heading of its surface, not a row in a list.

entries.name: CollapsibleSingleAccordion
entries.title: Collapsible — Single Mode
entries.description: Only one section open at a time, so a single body of content competes for attention. Use defaultValue to pre-expand whichever section a first-time reader needs. Each Collapsible owns a Section, so its trigger is that section heading.

entries.name: CollapsibleWithoutCard
entries.title: Collapsible — With Dividers
entries.description: A flat list on the page background with hand-placed Dividers, for detail panels and sidebars where cards would add too much weight. Rows, so the triggers step down to body-semibold and a supporting metadata line sits under each answer.

entries.name: table-collapsible
entries.title: Collapsible Table
entries.description: Several tables on one page, each in a collapsible card with its own columns — for groups that do not share a schema, where one table would stand full of empty cells. One time range drives them all, and rows expand into a history chart. Accounts, integrations, sections, sort, expand, or collapse.

entries.name: CollapsibleGroupShowcase
entries.title: CollapsibleGroup
entries.description: CollapsibleGroup coordinates its Collapsible children: with type="single", opening one closes the others. No state or handlers in the example — the group owns which value is open and each child only declares its own. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its default large type as the heading of its own surfa…

entries.name: CollapsibleGroupAccordion
entries.title: CollapsibleGroup — Density
entries.description: density sets the block padding on every row in the group, so a list of sections can be tuned to the surface it sits on without touching the rows. compact for dense surfaces like sidebars and inspectors, balanced (the default) for page content, spacious for a short list that is the main thing on the page. It follows Ta…

entries.name: CommandPaletteShowcase
entries.title: CommandPalette
entries.description: Basic command palette with static items and keyboard navigation.

entries.name: CommandPaletteAsyncSearch
entries.title: CommandPalette — Async Search
entries.description: Server-side search with loading spinner and custom empty states.

entries.name: CommandPaletteCustomFooter
entries.title: CommandPalette — Custom Footer
entries.description: Command palette with a custom footer tip message.

entries.name: CommandPaletteAutoGrouped
entries.title: CommandPalette — Grouped
entries.description: Command palette with items grouped via auxiliaryData.group.

entries.name: CommandPalettePickerMode
entries.title: CommandPalette — Picker Mode
entries.description: Single-value picker with persistent selection and check indicator.

entries.name: CommandPaletteRichItems
entries.title: CommandPalette — Rich Items
entries.description: Custom item rendering with icons, keyboard shortcuts, and keyword search.

entries.name: CommandPaletteEmptyShowcase
entries.title: CommandPaletteEmpty
entries.description: Command palette empty state shown when no commands are available.

entries.name: CommandPaletteEmptyBasic
entries.title: CommandPaletteEmpty — Basic
entries.description: A command palette with no results, showing a custom empty message via emptyBootstrapText. Use to explain why the palette is empty and what the user can do next.

entries.name: CommandPaletteFooterShowcase
entries.title: CommandPaletteFooter
entries.description: Command palette footer with custom tip content.

entries.name: CommandPaletteFooterBasic
entries.title: CommandPaletteFooter — Basic
entries.description: A command palette footer with no children, rendering the built-in keyboard navigation hints. Use CommandPaletteFooter without content to get the default arrow-key, Enter, and Esc hints below the results list.

entries.name: CommandPaletteGroupShowcase
entries.title: CommandPaletteGroup
entries.description: Command palette groups in both data-driven (auxiliaryData.group) and composed (CommandPaletteGroup + CommandPaletteItem) forms.

entries.name: CommandPaletteGroupBasic
entries.title: CommandPaletteGroup — Basic
entries.description: Command palette items organized under group headings using the composed CommandPaletteGroup form. Use to separate related commands into labeled sections.

entries.name: CommandPaletteInputShowcase
entries.title: CommandPaletteInput
entries.description: Command palette search input with a custom placeholder and a keyboard shortcut hint in the endContent slot.

entries.name: CommandPaletteInputBasic
entries.title: CommandPaletteInput — With End Content
entries.description: Custom placeholder and a keyboard shortcut badge in the trailing slot via endContent.

entries.name: CommandPaletteItemShowcase
entries.title: CommandPaletteItem
entries.description: An inline command palette whose items pair each command label with its keyboard shortcut through renderItem.

entries.name: CommandPaletteItemBasic
entries.title: CommandPaletteItem — Basic
entries.description: Selectable command palette items inside a CommandPaletteList, including highlighted and disabled states. Use when composing a palette manually instead of a search source.

entries.name: CommandPaletteListShowcase
entries.title: CommandPaletteList
entries.description: Scrollable command palette list with grouped items, including a highlighted item, composed without a full CommandPalette.

entries.name: CommandPaletteListBasic
entries.title: CommandPaletteList — Item States
entries.description: Flat list showing the highlighted, selected, and disabled item states. Use CommandPaletteGroup to add section headings.

entries.name: table-comparison
entries.title: Comparison Table
entries.description: Transposed matrix that puts candidates in the columns and criteria in grouped rows, with a pinned label column that survives horizontal scroll, columns you can swap or add, and best-in-row marks you can toggle. Compare, comparison, matrix, spec sheet, feature grid, pricing table, benchmark, frozen column, sticky colum…

entries.name: ComplexSelectorShowcase
entries.title: ComplexSelector
entries.description: A two-axis picker: choose a fruit and a ripeness level from one control. ComplexSelector owns the trigger, popover, and focus restore while the custom grid owns its keyboard semantics.

entries.name: ComplexSelectorDeadlinePicker
entries.title: ComplexSelector — Deadline Picker
entries.description: A multi-step deadline field: pick a preset like Today or Next week, or switch to a custom date and time before applying. The popup stays open until the user commits, so the content owns the Apply action.

entries.name: ComplexSelectorTreeSearch
entries.title: ComplexSelector — Tree Search
entries.description: A destination picker that combines a search field with a TreeList hierarchy. TreeList owns tree keyboard navigation; ComplexSelector owns the trigger, popover, and focus restore. Selecting a folder closes the popup.

entries.name: contact-form
entries.title: Contact Form
entries.description: Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit. No steps, no branching, no summary rail.

entries.name: ContextMenuShowcase
entries.title: ContextMenu
entries.description: An adaptive context area that supports long-press on compact touch screens and right-click elsewhere.

entries.name: ContextMenuBasic
entries.title: ContextMenu — Basic
entries.description: An adaptive context area: long-press opens a BottomSheet on compact touch screens, while right-click opens a cursor-positioned menu elsewhere.

entries.name: ContextMenuBottomSheet
entries.title: ContextMenu — Bottom Sheet
entries.description: A ContextMenu using the explicit BottomSheet presentation. Long-press the target on touch devices or right-click it with a pointer. Keep a visible menu trigger for important mobile actions.

entries.name: ContextMenuItemShowcase
entries.title: ContextMenuItem
entries.description: Context menu with custom-rendered items using ContextMenuItem for icons and descriptions.

entries.name: ContextMenuItemBasic
entries.title: ContextMenuItem — Basic
entries.description: Context menu items with labels and secondary descriptions. Use ContextMenuItem to render custom menu entries with consistent styling.

entries.name: course-detail
entries.title: Course Detail
entries.description: Long-form sales page for a single offering, in two columns — read the pitch, then enroll from a sticky rail. The main column holds a preview poster with a fact row, an about block with skill chips, a module syllabus whose sections collapse module by module, an instructor card, reviews with a scored-aspects panel, and…

entries.name: AnimatorPlayingCardsVanilla
entries.title: createAnimator — Playing cards in plain JavaScript
entries.description: The playing card from the useAnimator example, built in plain JavaScript with createAnimator and pointer events: it follows a drag, springs back on a gentle release, flies off with momentum on a quick flick, and a button discards it from the keyboard. React only mounts it.

entries.name: DragToSnapPointsCardVanilla
entries.title: createDragToSnapPoints — Playing card in plain JavaScript
entries.description: The three-place playing card from the useDragToSnapPoints example, built in plain JavaScript with createDragToSnapPoints: a sideways drag settles it on the nearest place or the next after a flick, buttons settle it from the keyboard, and a live region announces the place. React only mounts it.

entries.name: dashboard-comparison
entries.title: Data Dashboard
entries.description: Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that each carry an inline sparkline and several period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns underneath. Every number is shown against another number.

entries.name: DateInputShowcase
entries.title: DateInput
entries.description: A date input field with a calendar popover. Type a date or click the calendar icon to pick one.

entries.name: DateInputClearable
entries.title: DateInput — Clearable
entries.description: Date input with a clear button that resets the value. Use when the date field is optional and the user may need to undo their selection.

entries.name: DateInputWithDescription
entries.title: DateInput — Description
entries.description: Date input with helper text below the label explaining what the field expects. Use when the purpose of the date is not obvious from the label alone.

entries.name: DateInputFormats
entries.title: DateInput — Formats
entries.description: The format prop reuses Timestamp's format vocabulary to control how the committed value is displayed: date, date_long (default), date_weekday, and system_date, or a function for a fully custom string. Formatting applies only to the committed value, never to text the user is actively typing.

entries.name: DateInputDateRange
entries.title: DateInput — Min/Max Constraints
entries.description: Date input constrained to a min/max window. Use when only certain dates are valid, like booking availability or a fiscal quarter.

entries.name: DateInputWithValidation
entries.title: DateInput — Validation
entries.description: Date input in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface validation issues, caution the user, or confirm a valid selection.

entries.name: DateRangeInputShowcase
entries.title: DateRangeInput
entries.description: A date range picker with a button trigger and dual-month calendar popover with preset ranges.

entries.name: DateRangeInputWithValidation
entries.title: DateRangeInput — Validation
entries.description: Date range input in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface booking conflicts, flag high-demand periods, or confirm an available range.

entries.name: DateRangeInputWithPresets
entries.title: DateRangeInput — With Presets
entries.description: Date range picker with quick-select presets for common periods. Use for analytics dashboards, report filters, or any context where users frequently select standard time windows.

entries.name: DateTimeInputShowcase
entries.title: DateTimeInput
entries.description: A combined date and time picker. Desktop opens a calendar popover with a time input; touch devices open a Date/Time bottom sheet.

entries.name: DateTimeInputWithValidation
entries.title: DateTimeInput — Validation
entries.description: DateTimeInput in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface scheduling conflicts, caution the user about edge cases, or confirm a valid datetime.

entries.name: DialogShowcase
entries.title: Dialog
entries.description: Modal dialog with a header, body content, and close button.

entries.name: DialogAdaptivePresentation
entries.title: Dialog — Adaptive presentation
entries.description: Opt-in recipe for an AdaptiveDialog wrapper: Dialog remains the default everywhere, while touchPresentation="bottom-sheet" switches only at lg and below when pointer is coarse and hover is unavailable. Includes a deterministic presentation override for tests/unusual environments and notes that BottomSheet purpose cont…

entries.name: DialogConfirmationDialog
entries.title: Dialog — Confirmation
entries.description: Asks the user to confirm a destructive action before it happens. Use before deleting projects, removing team members, revoking API keys, or any irreversible operation.

entries.name: DialogFormDialog
entries.title: Dialog — Form
entries.description: Collects user input without navigating away from the page. Uses purpose="form" so clicking the backdrop won't close it. Use for editing profiles, creating items, or updating settings inline.

entries.name: DialogFullscreenDialog
entries.title: Dialog — Fullscreen
entries.description: Takes over the entire viewport for content that needs maximum space. Use for documentation viewers, rich text editors, multi-step wizards, or media previews where the standard dialog width is too narrow.

entries.name: DialogWithSubtitle
entries.title: Dialog — Required
entries.description: Cannot be dismissed by Escape or backdrop click; the user must explicitly choose an action. Uses purpose="required". Use for ownership transfers, legal acknowledgements, or critical decisions where skipping is not an option.

entries.name: DialogScrollingContent
entries.title: Dialog — Scrollable
entries.description: Constrains the dialog height and scrolls the body when content overflows. Use for terms and conditions, license agreements, changelogs, or any long-form content the user needs to review before accepting.

entries.name: form-wizard-dialog
entries.title: Dialog Wizard
entries.description: Step through a short flow in a dialog, overlay, or popup launched from the page underneath, which stays where it was. Compact step markers and a pinned action row inside a constrained width, rather than the full page a wizard usually gets. Best for two to four short steps — setup, invite, schedule, onboarding — where…

entries.name: DialogHeaderShowcase
entries.title: DialogHeader
entries.description: DialogHeader provides a structured header for dialogs with slots for title, subtitle, close button, and optional start or end content.

entries.name: DialogHeaderBasic
entries.title: DialogHeader — Basic
entries.description: A DialogHeader with a title, subtitle, and close button, placed in the header slot of a Dialog Layout. Pass onOpenChange to render the close button.

entries.name: DividerFullBleed
entries.title: Divider — Full Bleed
entries.description: Divider that extends past container padding to span the full width. Use inside cards or panels when you want a clean edge-to-edge separation, like between an order summary and total.

entries.name: DividerShowcase
entries.title: Divider — Variants
entries.description: Horizontal dividers in subtle and strong variants, plus a labeled divider. A quick visual reference for separator styles.

entries.name: DividerVariants
entries.title: Divider — Variants
entries.description: Subtle, labeled, and strong dividers in a single card. Use subtle between related sections, labeled for alternatives like "or", and strong for high-contrast boundaries.

entries.name: DividerVertical
entries.title: Divider — Vertical
entries.description: Vertical dividers separating side-by-side metrics. Use between stat cards, toolbar groups, or any horizontal layout where you need a visual boundary between sections.

entries.name: documentation
entries.title: Documentation Catalog
entries.description: Reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards linking into sections, with no article content on the surface itself.

entries.name: documentation-design
entries.title: Documentation Design
entries.description: Reference article alternating prose with live rendered examples: an interactive preview, a property table, paired do and don't comparisons, and copyable code blocks.

entries.name: documentation-technical
entries.title: Documentation Technical
entries.description: Reference article ordered as sequential numbered steps with code at each stage, plus callout cards for prerequisites and onward links. A linear walkthrough rather than a browsable reference.

entries.name: DrawerHeaderShowcase
entries.title: DrawerHeader
entries.description: DrawerHeader provides a structured header for drawers with slots for title, subtitle, close button, and optional start or end content.

entries.name: DropdownMenuShowcase
entries.title: DropdownMenu
entries.description: A button that opens a dropdown menu with action items. The menu starts open for preview.

entries.name: DropdownMenuActions
entries.title: DropdownMenu — Actions
entries.description: Action menu with dividers separating safe and destructive operations. Use for row-level actions on items like documents, projects, or records.

entries.name: DropdownMenuBottomSheet
entries.title: DropdownMenu — Adaptive presentation
entries.description: Chooses a bottom sheet for compact touch surfaces and an anchored popover otherwise. The media query is product policy, while DropdownMenu owns both presentations.

entries.name: DropdownMenuWithDisabledItems
entries.title: DropdownMenu — Disabled
entries.description: Menu with selectively disabled items based on permissions. Use when some actions require higher privileges, like admin-only operations.

entries.name: DropdownMenuNoChevron
entries.title: DropdownMenu — Icon Trigger
entries.description: Overflow menu triggered by an icon-only button with no chevron or label text. Use for row-level actions in tables, cards, or lists where a text button would take too much space.

entries.name: DropdownMenuWithSections
entries.title: DropdownMenu — Sections
entries.description: Menu items organized into titled sections for easy scanning. Use when you have 6+ actions that fall into distinct categories, like Create vs Manage.

entries.name: DropdownMenuWithSubmenu
entries.title: DropdownMenu — Submenu
entries.description: Action menu with a nested submenu. Hover or Right arrow opens the flyout; Left arrow / Escape closes it. Use to group related destinations or secondary actions without crowding the top level.

entries.name: DropdownMenuGroupShowcase
entries.title: DropdownMenuGroup
entries.description: A compound-mode menu whose rows are titled in groups. Each DropdownMenuGroup renders a role="group" named by its heading; arrow keys and typeahead skip the heading.

entries.name: DropdownMenuGroupWithSelectable
entries.title: DropdownMenuGroup — Selectable rows
entries.description: Titled groups around a radio group and checkbox rows — the rows the data API cannot express, which is why the heading lives in compound mode.

entries.name: DropdownMenuItemShowcase
entries.title: DropdownMenuItem
entries.description: Dropdown menu with custom-rendered items using DropdownMenuItem for icons and descriptions.

entries.name: DropdownMenuItemBasic
entries.title: DropdownMenuItem — Basic
entries.description: Dropdown menu items with labels and secondary descriptions. Use DropdownMenuItem to render custom menu entries with consistent styling.

entries.name: DrawerForm
entries.title: Edit form with footer actions
entries.description: Compose a Layout with DrawerHeader, the fields in LayoutContent, and Cancel and Save in a pinned LayoutFooter. purpose="form" keeps Escape but ignores scrim clicks, so a stray click outside does not discard edits.

entries.name: EmptyStateShowcase
entries.title: EmptyState
entries.description: A no-results empty state with an icon, descriptive message, and a call-to-action button.

entries.name: EmptyStateActions
entries.title: EmptyState — Actions
entries.description: Full empty state with icon, message, and action buttons. Use when a search returns no results, a filter clears all items, or a list has been emptied. The buttons give the user a way forward: go back, clear filters, or try a different query.

entries.name: EmptyStateCompact
entries.title: EmptyState — Compact
entries.description: Smaller empty state with reduced spacing for constrained areas. Use inside sidebar panels, card widgets, or notification drawers where a full-size empty state would overwhelm the layout.

entries.name: EmptyStateContainer
entries.title: EmptyState — Container
entries.description: Empty state wrapped in a Card for first-time setup or onboarding. Use when the user has not created any items yet, like a project list, team roster, or dashboard widget that will fill with data once they take action.

entries.name: dashboard-scorecard
entries.title: Executive Summary Dashboard
entries.description: Report-shaped analytics with a prose rail beside the charts: a scorecard of headline numbers with period deltas and status coloring, goal-attainment bars, a trend grid, and a written commentary column that folds beneath the content when narrow.

entries.name: FieldShowcase
entries.title: Field
entries.description: A form field wrapping a text input with a label, description, and validation status.

entries.name: FieldWithDescription
entries.title: Field — Description
entries.description: Fields with helper text below the label. Use descriptions to explain format requirements, constraints, or what happens with the data, like "At least 8 characters" or "We will send a confirmation link".

entries.name: FieldRequired
entries.title: Field — Required & Optional
entries.description: Required and optional field indicators side by side. Use isRequired on fields the user must fill in, and isOptional to clarify which fields can be skipped.

entries.name: FieldStatusVariants
entries.title: Field — Validation States
entries.description: All three validation states: error, warning, and success. Use error for invalid input, warning for potential issues like reserved names, and success to confirm valid entries like API keys.

entries.name: FieldLabelShowcase
entries.title: FieldLabel
entries.description: Standalone field labels demonstrating required, optional, tooltip, and icon variations.

entries.name: FieldLabelBasic
entries.title: FieldLabel — Basic
entries.description: Standalone labels with required and optional indicators and a helper description. Use when labeling a custom control that does not render its own label.

entries.name: FieldStatusShowcase
entries.title: FieldStatus
entries.description: Field status messages in error, warning, and success states with attached and detached variants.

entries.name: FieldStatusBasic
entries.title: FieldStatus — Basic
entries.description: Detached error and success messages for validation feedback. Use below checkboxes, switches, or custom controls where an attached status would overlap.

entries.name: file-explorer
entries.title: File Explorer
entries.description: Hierarchical browser that drills through nested levels as adjacent columns rather than replacing the list each time, with breadcrumb history, switchable list and grid density, and a metadata pane for the selected node.

entries.name: FileInputBasic
entries.title: FileInput — Basic
entries.description: A controlled single-file upload with accepted types, a size limit, and helper text. Use for standard document upload fields in forms.

entries.name: table-filter
entries.title: Filterable Table
entries.description: Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane.

entries.name: form-wizard
entries.title: Form Wizard
entries.description: Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields. Only the current step renders, unlike an accordion where each section expands into one long scrolling form. Each advan…

entries.name: FormLayoutShowcase
entries.title: FormLayout
entries.description: A vertical form layout with text input fields.

entries.name: FormLayoutHorizontal
entries.title: FormLayout — Horizontal
entries.description: Two fields side by side for naturally paired inputs like first and last name

entries.name: FormLayoutMixedControls
entries.title: FormLayout — Mixed Controls
entries.description: Form with different control types: text input, selector, and checkboxes

entries.name: FormLayoutNested
entries.title: FormLayout — Nested Address Form
entries.description: Address form mixing vertical and horizontal layouts for grouped fields

entries.name: FormLayoutHorizontalLabels
entries.title: FormLayout — Settings Form
entries.description: Settings form with labels placed beside their inputs

entries.name: dashboard-cohort-funnel
entries.title: Funnel & Cohort Dashboard
entries.description: Analytics for sequence and retention questions, pairing two shapes a plain dashboard cannot hold: a staged funnel where each step reads as drop-off against the one before, and a two-axis cohort matrix rendered as a heatmap.

entries.name: gallery-hero
entries.title: Gallery Hero
entries.description: Centered stack (headline, short blurb, call-to-action buttons) resolving into a multi-image photo grid rather than one wide full-bleed picture, so the imagery reads as a set.

entries.name: GridGalleryExample
entries.title: Grid — Card Gallery
entries.description: Card gallery with responsive columns that maintain consistent widths

entries.name: GridWithGridSpan
entries.title: Grid — Column Spanning
entries.description: Grid with featured items spanning multiple columns and rows

entries.name: GridDashboardLayout
entries.title: Grid — Dashboard Layout
entries.description: Dashboard layout with mixed-size widgets and a full-width summary row

entries.name: GridResponsiveAutoFit
entries.title: Grid — Responsive Auto-Fit
entries.description: Responsive grid where cards stretch to fill remaining space

entries.name: GridSpanShowcase
entries.title: GridSpan
entries.description: GridSpan lets a grid item span multiple columns or rows within an Grid, enabling masonry-style and asymmetric layouts.

entries.name: GridSpanColumns
entries.title: GridSpan — Columns
entries.description: Grid items spanning two of three columns. Wrap a grid child in GridSpan to make it occupy multiple columns for asymmetric layouts.

entries.name: table-grouped
entries.title: Grouped Table
entries.description: Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse. Query filtering and a resizable inspector for the selected row.

entries.name: HeadingCardGrid
entries.title: Heading — Card Grid
entries.description: Responsive card grid with truncated headings and descriptions for uniform layout

entries.name: HeadingPageLayout
entries.title: Heading — Page Hierarchy
entries.description: Real-world page layout demonstrating heading levels h1 through h3 with supporting text

entries.name: HeadingTruncation
entries.title: Heading — Truncation
entries.description: Single-line and multi-line heading truncation with ellipsis for constrained layouts

entries.name: HoverCardShowcase
entries.title: HoverCard
entries.description: A hover card that shows a user profile preview when hovering over a trigger button. Starts open for preview.

entries.name: HoverCardInlineTextHoverCard
entries.title: HoverCard — Definition
entries.description: Shows a term definition on hover within a paragraph. Use for technical terms, jargon, or concepts that some readers may not know, like a glossary built into the text.

entries.name: HoverCardInteractiveContent
entries.title: HoverCard — Link Preview
entries.description: Shows a page summary when hovering a link: title, description, and URL. Use for documentation links, article references, or any URL where a preview helps the user decide whether to click.

entries.name: HoverCardProfileHoverCard
entries.title: HoverCard — Profile Preview
entries.description: Shows a user profile summary on hover with name, role, and bio. Use on usernames, avatars, or mentions to let users preview a profile without navigating away.

entries.name: HStackShowcase
entries.title: HStack
entries.description: Demonstrates HStack arranging items horizontally with different gaps and alignments.

entries.name: HStackBasic
entries.title: HStack — Basic
entries.description: Items arranged in a horizontal row with a consistent gap and centered vertical alignment. Use HStack whenever siblings should sit side by side.

entries.name: IconNonSemanticColors
entries.title: Icon — Non-Semantic Colors
entries.description: Non-semantic color palette for icons.

entries.name: IconSemanticColors
entries.title: Icon — Semantic Colors
entries.description: All semantic icon color variants with labels.

entries.name: IconSizes
entries.title: Icon — Size Variants
entries.description: All icon sizes from extra-small to large.

entries.name: IconStatusIcons
entries.title: Icon — Status Indicators
entries.description: Status list using semantic icons for success, warning, error, and info.

entries.name: IconButtonShowcase
entries.title: IconButton
entries.description: An icon button with a wrench icon.

entries.name: IconButtonActionBar

entries.name: ide
entries.title: IDE
entries.description: Dense multi-pane workspace of resizable, collapsible regions: a hierarchy tree on one flank, tabbed documents in the middle, a docked drawer along the bottom, an inspector opposite. Drag a divider to resize or collapse any of them.

entries.name: table-inbox
entries.title: Inbox Table
entries.description: Two-pane message queue: the table indexes a reading pane rather than being the destination, with a divider you drag to resize. Rows stack when the table narrows, not the window; threads read as collapsible messages; replying opens a composer that leaves the list live.

entries.name: form-wizard-inline
entries.title: Inline Wizard
entries.description: Accordion wizard stacking every step in one column: the active step expands in place while finished ones collapse to a single line carrying their result and a way back in. entries.name: ItemDocumentTabs
entries.title: Item — Document Tabs
entries.description: Single-row, horizontally scrollable document switcher with compact selected rows, leading file icons, instant reveal-on-hover close actions with reserved geometry, stable separators, and an add control outside the scroll area. entries.name: ItemWithMetadata

entries.name: ItemWithMedia
entries.title: Item — Start Content
entries.description: Items with leading avatars and icons in the startContent slot. Keep start content small so the row stays compact and easy to scan.

entries.name: kanban-board
entries.title: Kanban Board
entries.description: Horizontal lanes of draggable cards where the column itself is the status, so drag and drop between lanes is the state change. Fixed columns, variable-height cards.

entries.name: KbdInlineInstructions

entries.name: KbdModifierCombos

entries.name: LayoutDualPanelLayout

entries.name: LayoutFullBleedContent

entries.name: LayoutFooterShowcase

entries.name: LayoutHeaderWithActions

entries.name: LayoutPanelShowcase
entries.title: LayoutPanel
entries.description: LayoutPanel is a sidebar slot within a Layout, used for navigation, detail views, or secondary content alongside the main content area.

entries.name: LayoutPanelNavigation
entries.title: LayoutPanel — Navigation

entries.name: LightboxShowcase
entries.title: Lightbox
entries.description: A fullscreen image viewer with caption.

entries.description: Metadata list with a show-more toggle after a set number of items.
