entries.description: A plan picker with single-select radio behavior. Cards show an accent border when selected.

entries.name: SelectableCardElevated
entries.title: SelectableCard — Elevated
entries.description: Raised selectable cards with `elevation="low"`. The inset selection ring composes on top of the shadow, so a selected card keeps its elevation.

entries.name: SelectableCardMulti
entries.title: SelectableCardMulti
entries.description: Multi-select tag picker using color variant selectable cards with color-matched selection borders.

entries.name: SelectorBottomSheet
entries.title: Selector — Bottom Sheet
entries.description: Presents a single-selection list in a bottom sheet for compact touch interfaces.

entries.name: SelectorClearable
entries.title: Selector — Clearable
entries.description: Selector with a clear button to reset the selected value.

entries.name: SelectorGhostToolbar
entries.title: Selector — Ghost Toolbar
entries.description: Borderless Selector variant composed with ghost buttons in a toolbar.

entries.name: SelectorWithSections
entries.title: Selector — Grouped Sections
entries.description: Selector with options grouped into labeled sections.

entries.name: SelectorOptionDescriptions
entries.title: Selector — Option descriptions
entries.description: Options carry a description, so the dropdown draws a two-line row. The closed trigger is sized by padding, so it is the size token for a one-line value and exactly one line taller for a two-line one; both on the 4px rhythm. An InputGroup pins the row, so the value folds back onto one line there.

entries.name: SelectorWithStatus
entries.title: Selector — Validation States
entries.description: Selector showing error, warning, and success validation states.

entries.name: SelectorOptionShowcase
entries.title: SelectorOption
entries.description: Selector with custom-rendered options using SelectorOption for icons and descriptions.

entries.name: SelectorOptionBasic
entries.title: SelectorOption — Basic
entries.description: A selector whose options are rendered with SelectorOption, adding a secondary description below each label. Use inside renderOption for consistent custom option styling.

entries.name: dashboard-alert-rail
entries.title: Service Monitoring Dashboard
entries.description: Always-on analytics with a triage rail: status-colored tiles with sparklines, multi-series time charts over a switchable window, and an independently scrolling alert column that folds into the content when narrow.

entries.name: settings-dialog
entries.title: Settings Dialog
entries.description: Preferences inside a modal container with searchable section navigation, so configuration happens without leaving whatever is underneath. Grouped toggles, live preview of appearance choices, rebindable shortcuts.

entries.name: settings
entries.title: Settings Form
entries.description: Preferences as one continuously scrolling form, sections stacked in order with no navigation between them. The simplest settings shape: everything reachable by scrolling.

entries.name: settings-sidebar
entries.title: Settings Panels
entries.description: Preferences split into nav-switched panels: a persistent section list swaps the pane beside it, and rows edit in place rather than opening a separate form.

entries.name: shell-nav
entries.title: Shell Nav
entries.description: Application frame combining both navigation axes: a top menu bar with command-palette search over a resizable hierarchy rail, wrapping placeholder content. For when one axis is not enough.

entries.name: InternationalizationProvider04Calendar
entries.title: Show Calendar and DateInput in another calendar
entries.description: Set the `calendar` prop and the `Calendar` and `DateInput` inside the provider show that calendar system. The value stays a Gregorian ISO date. Japanese and Buddhist dates work in every browser; calendars such as Persian or Hebrew also need `Temporal` or a polyfill.

entries.name: side-gallery
entries.title: Side Gallery
entries.description: Asymmetric split section: a copy column of headline, supporting text, and links held against a clustered image collage opposite. Deliberately off-balance, unlike the centered hero.

entries.name: shell-side-nav
entries.title: Side Nav
entries.description: Application frame with a single collapsible, resizable left rail carrying grouped history and search, wrapping the main content. Vertical navigation only, no top bar.

entries.name: SideNavEndContent
entries.title: SideNav — End Content
entries.description: Side navigation items with badges, counts, and context menus as trailing content.

entries.name: SideNavWithHeaderMenu
entries.title: SideNav — Header with Menu
entries.description: Side navigation with an account switcher dropdown in the header for multi-account apps.

entries.name: SideNavNestedItems
entries.title: SideNav — Nested Items
entries.description: Side navigation with collapsible nested items for settings or hierarchical menus.

entries.name: SideNavCollapseButtonShowcase
entries.title: SideNavCollapseButton
entries.description: Demonstrates SideNavCollapseButton inside a collapsible SideNav.

entries.name: SideNavCollapseButtonBasic
entries.title: SideNavCollapseButton — Basic
entries.description: Place a collapse button in the SideNav footer to let users toggle the rail between expanded and collapsed states. Disable the built-in button via collapsible={{hasButton: false}} when positioning it yourself.

entries.name: SideNavHeadingShowcase
entries.title: SideNavHeading
entries.description: Demonstrates SideNavHeading with an app name, logo icon, superheading, and subheading.

entries.name: SideNavHeadingBasic
entries.title: SideNavHeading — Basic
entries.description: A SideNav header with an app icon and a linked title. Pass it to the SideNav header prop to identify the product or workspace at the top of the navigation rail.

entries.name: SideNavItemShowcase
entries.title: SideNavItem
entries.description: Demonstrates SideNavItem with selected, icon, disabled, and nested states.

entries.name: SideNavItemBasic
entries.title: SideNavItem — Basic
entries.description: Navigation links inside a SideNav, each with a label, an icon, and an href. Mark the item for the current page with isSelected.

entries.name: SideNavSectionShowcase
entries.title: SideNavSection
entries.description: Demonstrates SideNavSection with titled groups of navigation items.

entries.name: SideNavSectionBasic
entries.title: SideNavSection — Basic
entries.description: Group related SideNavItems under titled sections. Use sections to organize longer navigation lists into scannable clusters like Overview and Account.

entries.name: table
entries.title: Simple Table
entries.description: Flat row collection where columns sort, rows select into a bulk-action toolbar, and each row carries an overflow menu. Sortable but ungrouped, with no detail pane, the baseline shape.

entries.name: SkeletonShowcase
entries.title: Skeleton
entries.description: A skeleton loading placeholder.

entries.name: SkeletonCardSkeleton
entries.title: Skeleton — Card Loading
entries.description: Card skeleton with avatar, name, and content lines.

entries.name: SkeletonStaggeredList
entries.title: Skeleton — Staggered List
entries.description: Staggered skeleton lines with varying widths.

entries.name: SkeletonTableRowSkeleton
entries.title: Skeleton — Table Rows
entries.description: Table skeleton with staggered column widths.

entries.name: DrawerStart
entries.title: Slide in from the start edge
entries.description: Set side="start" to open from the inline start edge: left in LTR and right in RTL. The default end edge follows the inspector convention.

entries.name: SliderShowcase
entries.title: Slider
entries.description: A slider control set to 50%.

entries.name: SliderFormattedValue
entries.title: Slider — Formatted Value
entries.description: Slider with custom formatting showing temperature in Fahrenheit.

entries.name: SliderRangeSlider
entries.title: Slider — Range
entries.description: Range slider for selecting a value range like price bounds.

entries.name: SliderWithStatus
entries.title: Slider — Validation States
entries.description: Sliders with error, warning, and success validation states.

entries.name: SliderWithMarks
entries.title: Slider — With Marks
entries.description: Slider with labeled tick marks at fixed intervals.

entries.name: SpinnerShowcase
entries.title: Spinner
entries.description: A large spinner indicator.

entries.name: SpinnerOnMedia
entries.title: Spinner — On Media Shade
entries.description: Default and onMedia shade spinners for light and dark backgrounds.

entries.name: SpinnerSizes
entries.title: Spinner — Sizes
entries.description: All spinner sizes displayed side by side.

entries.name: SpinnerWithLabel
entries.title: Spinner — With Label
entries.description: Spinners with text and rich multi-line labels.

entries.name: StackAlignment
entries.title: Stack — Alignment
entries.description: Buttons positioned at the start, center, and end of a row.

entries.name: StackDirections
entries.title: Stack — Directions
entries.description: Badges arranged horizontally and vertically in side-by-side cards.

entries.name: StackFillItem
entries.title: Stack — Fill Item
entries.description: An avatar, text, and button in a row; the text stretches to fill the available space.

entries.name: StackItemShowcase
entries.title: StackItem
entries.description: StackItem can be used within HStack or VStack for more granular control over individual item sizing and alignment, but is optional; stack children work without it.

entries.name: StackItemFill
entries.title: StackItem — Fill
entries.description: A static-width item next to one that fills the remaining space. Wrap stack children in StackItem when an item needs explicit sizing control.

entries.name: StatusDotShowcase
entries.title: StatusDot
entries.description: A positive status dot indicator.

entries.name: StatusDotPulsing
entries.title: StatusDot — Pulsing
entries.description: Animated pulsing dots for live, processing, and error states.

entries.name: StatusDotStatusIndicators
entries.title: StatusDot — Status Indicators
entries.description: Labeled status dot list for presence indicators like online, away, and offline.

entries.name: StatusDotVariants
entries.title: StatusDot — Variants
entries.description: All five semantic color variants displayed in a row.

entries.name: StepShowcase
entries.title: Step
entries.description: A single Step, with every part it can render: the indicator, the label with its optional marker and trailing endContent, and the description beneath. A Step never sets its own completed/current state. It declares its index and derives the rest from the parent Stepper, so one Step in one Stepper is a complete example.

entries.name: StepContent
entries.title: Step — Content Slot
entries.description: Children passed to a Step render below its description, indented to line up with the label rather than the indicator, and stay outside the clickable label area so buttons inside remain their own targets. In a full flow you gate the slot on the step being active. That is what turns a vertical stepper into an expanding…

entries.name: StepIndicator
entries.title: Step — Indicator
entries.description: Everything the indicator prop accepts: the auto default, an always-number badge, a custom ReactNode, and none, each on its own completed Step so the prop is the only difference between them. Every variant occupies the same 16px box, so a step swapping its number for a check as it completes never shifts the label besid…

entries.name: StepStates
entries.title: Step — States
entries.description: Every state a single Step can land in, each shown as one Step in its own Stepper. Completed, current, and upcoming are derived by comparing the step index against the parent activeStep, so they are never set directly; isDisabled and status are the two a step declares itself. Status is a separate axis from progress, wh…

entries.name: StepperShowcase
entries.title: Stepper — Checkout Progress
entries.description: The default stepper: a horizontal track where every step owns an equal segment of the progress bar above its label. The default auto indicator resolves itself per step: a check once the step is done, a ring on the current step, a number for the ones still ahead. Click any step to jump.

entries.name: StepperCustomContent
entries.title: Stepper — Custom Content
entries.description: A vertical stepper where each step owns a slice of the page. The content slot takes any node (form fields, a summary panel, a banner), so a stepper is not limited to multi-step forms. Rendering the slot only for the active step is what makes the flow expand one step at a time.

entries.name: StepperWidthResponsiveCollapse
entries.title: Stepper — Horizontal Narrow Collapsed
entries.description: A narrow horizontal stepper using horizontalOptions. At 320px wide, four steps fall below the 112px minimumStepWidth and collapse into a current-step summary with Previous and Next controls.

entries.name: StepperIndicatorModes
entries.title: Stepper — Indicator Modes
entries.description: The indicator prop side by side: none (the bar and label carry the progress on their own), auto (check when done, ring when current, number ahead), always-number, and a custom icon per step.

entries.name: StepperOnTrackHorizontal
entries.title: Stepper — On-Track Horizontal
entries.description: The on-track layout in horizontal orientation: instead of sitting beside the label, each indicator is slotted into the connector itself, so the numbered nodes read as beads on one continuous line. Labels center under their node.

entries.name: StepperOnTrackVertical
entries.title: Stepper — On-Track Vertical
entries.description: The on-track layout in vertical orientation: indicators sit inline on a continuous connector rail, with each label and description beside its node. Compare with the separated layout, where the indicator sits alongside its own bar segment instead of on a shared rail.

entries.name: StepperStatus
entries.title: Stepper — Validation Status
entries.description: Semantic status per step in a verification flow: success shows a green check, error a red glyph, accent the in-progress step. Status sets the indicator color and glyph only, never the connector, and is announced to assistive tech as text.

entries.name: SwitchShowcase
entries.title: Switch
entries.description: A toggle switch for enabling notifications.

entries.name: SwitchDisabled
entries.title: Switch — Disabled
entries.description: Disabled switch with label and description for gated features.

entries.name: SwitchSettingsPanel
entries.title: Switch — Settings Panel
entries.description: Settings panel with spread-spaced switches in a card.

entries.name: SwitchWithDescription
entries.title: Switch — With Description
entries.description: Toggle with a label and supporting description text.

entries.name: SwitchWithStatus
entries.title: Switch — With Status
entries.description: Switches with error, warning, and success validation states.

entries.name: SyntaxThemeShowcase
entries.title: SyntaxTheme — Compact Preset
entries.description: A concise code block rendered with the One Dark Pro syntax preset to show how SyntaxTheme changes highlighting colors without making the page long.

entries.name: SyntaxThemeDarkPreset
entries.title: SyntaxTheme — Dark Preset
entries.description: Wrap a code block in SyntaxTheme to apply a dark syntax preset such as Dracula.

entries.name: SyntaxThemeLightPreset
entries.title: SyntaxTheme — Light Preset
entries.description: Use a light syntax preset for code examples that need to sit on light documentation surfaces.

entries.name: TabShowcase
entries.title: Tab
entries.description: Tab is an individual tab item within a TabList, supporting labels, icons, selected icons, and end content slots.

entries.name: TabWithSelectedIcon
entries.title: Tab — Selected Icon
entries.description: A tab that changes its icon when selected.

entries.name: TableShowcase
entries.title: Table
entries.description: Data-driven table with proportional and pixel column widths and hover highlighting.

entries.name: TableColumnSettingsTable
entries.title: Table — Column Settings
entries.description: Table with a column visibility picker in the toolbar. Toggle columns on and off.

entries.name: TableGridDividersTable
entries.title: Table — Grid Dividers
entries.description: Compact table with grid dividers showing both row and column borders, suited for dense numeric data.

entries.name: TableInCard
entries.title: Table — In Card
entries.description: Table composed inside a card with a heading, demonstrating container bleed alignment.

entries.name: TableInlineFilterTable
entries.title: Table — Inline Filters
entries.description: Table with inline filter controls rendered directly below each column header.

entries.name: TablePaginatedTable
entries.title: Table — Paginated Data
entries.description: Paginated data table navigating through a larger dataset page by page.

entries.name: TableFilterableTable
entries.title: Table — Popover Filters
entries.description: Table with popover filter controls triggered by icons in column headers.

entries.name: TableResizableTable
entries.title: Table — Resizable Columns
entries.description: Table with draggable column resize handles. Drag the right edge of any header to resize.

entries.name: TableRichCellTable
entries.title: Table — Rich Cell Content
entries.description: Table with rich cell content using Link for emails and Badge for role labels.

entries.name: TableSelectableTable
entries.title: Table — Row Selection
entries.description: Table with row selection checkboxes and a select-all header checkbox.

entries.name: TableLeadingMarkSelection
entries.title: Table — Selection in the Leading Mark
entries.description: Selection without a checkbox column: each item shows its avatar, and the checkbox takes the avatar slot while a mouse is over it, on keyboard focus, and everywhere once anything is selected; on touch screens it always shows. The state comes from useTableSelectionState, and the checkboxes render in the name column inst…

entries.name: TableSortableTable
entries.title: Table — Sortable Columns
entries.description: Table with sortable columns, click headers to sort ascending or descending.

entries.name: TableStripedTable
entries.title: Table — Striped Rows
entries.description: Table with alternating row colors and hover highlighting for easy scanning.

entries.name: TableBulkActionsTable
entries.title: Table: Bulk Actions
entries.description: Controlled row selection with the reusable TableSelectionToolbar rendered in flow above the table. Product actions occupy the logical start; synchronized selection count and complete clear action occupy the logical end.

entries.name: TableFloatingBulkActionsTable
entries.title: Table: Floating Bulk Actions
entries.description: The reusable TableSelectionToolbar inside a capped, self-contained scroll region for a long non-sticky table below metric cards. The caller-owned sticky placement keeps actions 16px from the example scrollport without moving the table when selection changes.

entries.name: TabListTabsFillLayout
entries.title: TabList — Fill Layout
entries.description: Tabs that stretch to fill the available width with a bottom divider.

entries.name: TabListTabsWithActions
entries.title: TabList — With Actions
entries.description: Page header pattern with tabs on the left and action buttons pushed to the right. When hasDivider is true, match the Button size to the TabList size so the tabs and actions align to a shared baseline above the divider.

entries.name: TabListTabsWithBadge
entries.title: TabList — With Badge
entries.description: Tabs with notification badge counts rendered via endContent. Uses error variant for urgent counts and neutral for informational ones.

entries.name: TabListTabsWithIcons
entries.title: TabList — With Icons
entries.description: Tabs with leading icons alongside text labels.

entries.name: TabListTabsWithMenu
entries.title: TabList — With Overflow Menu
entries.description: Tab list with a dropdown menu for additional items that do not fit inline.

entries.name: TabListTabsWithStatusDot
entries.title: TabList — With Status Dot
entries.description: Tabs with status dot indicators rendered via endContent to show live environment health at a glance.

entries.name: TabMenuShowcase
entries.title: TabMenu
entries.description: TabMenu is an overflow menu within a TabList that groups additional tab options into a dropdown, showing the selected option's label as the trigger text.

entries.name: TabMenuBasic
entries.title: TabMenu — Basic
entries.description: An overflow menu at the end of a TabList that collects secondary tabs behind a dropdown. Use it when there are more tabs than fit comfortably inline.

entries.name: TextColors
entries.title: Text — Colors
entries.description: All text color options (primary, secondary, disabled, placeholder, active) applied to body text to show their intended use.

entries.name: TextHeadingLevels
entries.title: Text — Heading Levels
entries.description: All 6 heading levels (h1 through h6) rendered with Heading to show the full type scale.

entries.name: TextInline
entries.title: Text — Inline
entries.description: Mixing body and code text inline within a single line using the default inline display mode.

entries.name: TextTruncation
entries.title: Text — Truncation
entries.description: Single-line and multi-line text truncation with ellipsis using maxLines in a width-constrained container.

entries.name: TextTypes
entries.title: Text — Types
entries.description: All 5 semantic text types (body, large, label, supporting, code) with their default styling from the theme.

entries.name: TextWeight
entries.title: Text — Weight
entries.description: The 4 font weight variants (normal, medium, semibold, bold) applied to body text.

entries.name: TextWordBreak
entries.title: Text — Word Break
entries.description: Compares break-word and break-all word break modes on a long unbreakable string.

entries.name: TextWrap
entries.title: Text — Wrap
entries.description: The 4 text-wrap modes (wrap, nowrap, balance, pretty) shown in width-constrained containers.

entries.name: TextAreaShowcase
entries.title: TextArea
entries.description: A text area with placeholder text.

entries.name: TextAreaCharacterCount
entries.title: TextArea — Character Count
entries.description: Textareas with maxLength and a live character counter. The counter turns red when the limit is exceeded.

entries.name: TextAreaWithIcon
entries.title: TextArea — Icon
entries.description: Textareas with a leading icon that hints at the expected content, like a chat bubble for messages or a pencil for notes.

entries.name: TextAreaStates
entries.title: TextArea — States
entries.description: Required, disabled, and loading textareas side by side. Shows the interactive states the component supports.

entries.name: TextAreaValidation
entries.title: TextArea — Validation
entries.description: All three status variants (error, warning, and success) with status messages, plus error without a message. Use to show inline validation feedback as the user types.

entries.name: TextInputIcon
entries.title: TextInput — Icon
entries.description: Inputs with a leading icon that hints at the expected content. Use when the icon helps users identify the field faster, like a lock for passwords or an envelope for email.

entries.name: TextInputSearch
entries.title: TextInput — Search
entries.description: Search input with a hidden label, start icon, and clear button. Use for toolbar and header search bars where the icon provides sufficient context.

entries.name: TextInputSizes
entries.title: TextInput — Sizes
entries.description: Small, medium, and large inputs side by side. Use small in dense UIs like table filters, medium for most forms, and large for prominent single-field pages.

entries.name: TextInputStates
entries.title: TextInput — States
entries.description: Error, warning, and success validation states with status messages. Use to show users what went wrong and how to fix it.

entries.name: TextInputStatusVariant
entries.title: TextInput — Status variant
entries.description: The statusVariant prop controls whether the status message is attached to the bordered input (default, overlapping directly below) or detached from it (floating below as a separate element with spacing).

entries.name: TextInputTypes
entries.title: TextInput — Types
entries.description: Text, password, and email types plus field-level features: tooltip, required, optional, description, disabled, and loading.

entries.name: ThemeApply
entries.title: Theme — Apply Theme
entries.description: Wrap a subtree in Theme to apply a theme to every child component in that region.

entries.name: ThemeShowcase
entries.title: Theme — Distinct Themes
entries.description: Two visually distinct theme providers wrapping identical content to show how Theme changes the visual treatment of child components.

entries.name: ThemeNested
entries.title: Theme — Nested Theme
entries.description: Nested Theme providers let a local region use a different theme without affecting the rest of the page.

entries.name: ThemeSwitcher
entries.title: Theme — Switch Themes
entries.description: Use state to switch the theme object passed to Theme and preview a different visual treatment.

entries.name: theme-showcase
entries.title: Theme Showcase
entries.description: Multi-surface comparison shell: preview palettes, typography, icons and control states across a storefront, checkout, chat and inventory on one responsive canvas. A theme preview and design-system showcase, with an embeddable content view for an existing app shell.

entries.name: ThumbnailShowcase
entries.title: Thumbnail
entries.description: A thumbnail with an image and label.

entries.name: ThumbnailDisabled
entries.title: Thumbnail — Disabled
entries.description: Thumbnails in the disabled state with reduced opacity. The open and remove buttons stay focusable and announced as disabled, and call nothing.

entries.name: ThumbnailGallery
entries.title: Thumbnail — Gallery
entries.description: A row of clickable thumbnails with labels that open a detail view. Use for image attachment lists where users need to preview and manage uploads.

entries.name: ThumbnailRemovable
entries.title: Thumbnail — Removable
entries.description: Thumbnails with a remove button overlay. The close button uses APCA luminance detection to stay visible on both dark and light images.

entries.name: ThumbnailStates
entries.title: Thumbnail — States
entries.description: All visual states side by side: image loaded, placeholder, skeleton loading, and upload overlay. Demonstrates the full lifecycle of a thumbnail from empty to loaded.

entries.name: TimeInputShowcase
entries.title: TimeInput
entries.description: A time input that uses the browser/OS picker on touch by default and Astryx typed entry on fine pointers.

entries.name: TimeInputConstrained
entries.title: TimeInput — Constrained
entries.description: Time inputs with min/max constraints limiting selection to specific windows. Use to prevent out-of-bounds selections for appointments, reservations, or shift scheduling.

entries.name: TimeInputFormats
entries.title: TimeInput — Formats
entries.description: 12-hour, 24-hour, and seconds formats side by side. Use 12h for US-centric UIs, 24h for international or technical contexts, and seconds for precise timing.

entries.name: TimeInputIncrement
entries.title: TimeInput — Increment
entries.description: Time input with a custom step increment. Arrow keys jump by the specified interval (e.g. 15 minutes) for quick slot-based scheduling.

entries.name: TimeInputStates
entries.title: TimeInput — States
entries.description: Default, disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use status messages to give users clear feedback about their time selection.

entries.name: TimerFormats
entries.title: Timer — Formats
entries.description: Elapsed compact units and stopwatch clock notation shown from the same start time.

entries.name: TimerInline
entries.title: Timer — Inline
entries.description: A Timer composed into status copy while inheriting the surrounding typography.

entries.name: TimerTypography
entries.title: Timer — Typography
entries.description: Timer using its Timestamp-matched default typography and an emphasized override.

entries.name: TimestampAutoFormat
entries.title: Timestamp — Auto
entries.description: Auto format that shows relative time for recent dates and switches to the full date for older ones. The default choice for most use cases.

entries.name: TimestampColors
entries.title: Timestamp — Colors
entries.description: Timestamp rendered in each available color variant: primary, secondary, disabled, and active.

entries.name: TimestampFormats
entries.title: Timestamp — Formats
entries.description: All display formats side by side: date, date_time, time, and their system equivalents. Use date and date_time for user-facing UI, system variants for logs and dev tools.

entries.name: TimestampRelativeFormat
entries.title: Timestamp — Relative
entries.description: Relative time labels from seconds to months ago, with hover tooltips showing the full date. Use in feeds, comment threads, and activity logs.

entries.name: TimestampTimezone
entries.title: Timestamp — Timezone
entries.description: Timestamps with the timezone abbreviation appended. Enable isTimezoneShown for audiences across time zones, like audit logs or team calendars.

entries.name: TimestampTooltipTimezones
entries.title: Timestamp — Tooltip time zones
entries.description: Hover tooltips that show one instant across several time zones or formats. Use tooltipEntries when readers must compare zones, like an incident log carrying both the reader's time and the event's origin zone.

entries.name: ToastShowcase
entries.title: Toast
entries.description: Imperative toast notifications triggered with useToast and rendered in the toast viewport.

entries.name: ToastAction
entries.title: Toast — Action
entries.description: Persistent toasts with a trailing button or link so the user can act on the notification, like undoing a delete or viewing a report.

entries.name: ToastDeduplication
entries.title: Toast — Deduplication
entries.description: Prevent duplicate toasts with uniqueID. Use ignore to keep the first toast, or overwrite to replace it with updated content like a progress percentage.

entries.name: ToastDismiss
entries.title: Toast — Dismiss
entries.description: Show a persistent toast and dismiss it programmatically using the function returned by useToast. Use for long-running operations that need manual cleanup.

entries.name: ToastStacking
entries.title: Toast — Stacking
entries.description: Multiple toasts stacking vertically with smooth enter and exit animations. Click repeatedly to see how toasts queue and dismiss.

entries.name: ToastTypes
entries.title: Toast — Types
entries.description: Info and error toast variants side by side. Info toasts auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, error toasts persist until the user dismisses them.

entries.name: ToggleButtonColor
entries.title: ToggleButton — Color
entries.description: Toggle buttons with colored icons in the pressed state. Shows accent-colored toolbar formatting and semantic reaction colors (yellow star, red heart, blue bookmark).

entries.name: ToggleButtonGroup
entries.title: ToggleButton — Group
entries.description: Toggle button groups in single-select and multi-select modes. Single selection acts as a view mode switcher; multiple selection forms a formatting toolbar.

entries.name: ToggleButtonIconSwap
entries.title: ToggleButton — Icon Swap
entries.description: Icon-only toggle buttons that swap between outline and solid icons when pressed. Use for actions like favorite, bookmark, or mute where the icon itself communicates the state.

entries.name: ToggleButtonLabel
entries.title: ToggleButton — Label
entries.description: Toggle buttons with visible text labels that show a font weight shift on press. Use when the icon alone is not enough to communicate the action.

entries.name: ToggleButtonStates
entries.title: ToggleButton — States
entries.description: Default, pressed, disabled, and loading states of a standalone toggle button. Shows how visual treatment changes across states.

entries.name: ToggleButtonGroupShowcase
entries.title: ToggleButtonGroup
entries.description: ToggleButtonGroup manages a set of ToggleButtons with single-select or multi-select behavior for options like view modes or filters.

entries.name: ToggleButtonGroupVertical
entries.title: ToggleButtonGroup — Vertical
entries.description: A vertically stacked ToggleButtonGroup using the vertical orientation, shown with both single-select and multi-select behavior, ideal for sidebar-style option lists and vertical toolbars.

entries.name: TokenClickable
entries.title: Token — Clickable
entries.description: Interactive tokens that respond to clicks. Use for toggleable filters or tokens that open a detail view when selected.

entries.name: TokenColors
entries.title: Token — Colors
entries.description: All 11 color variants in default and disabled states. Use color to categorize entities or convey status at a glance.

entries.name: TokenEndContent
entries.title: Token — End Content
entries.description: Tokens with trailing content like a count badge or status indicator after the label. Use for notification counts, item quantities, or compact status info.

entries.name: TokenIcon
entries.title: Token — Icon
entries.description: Tokens with a leading icon that identifies the entity type. Use when the icon helps users recognize the token category faster, like a user icon for people or a tag icon for labels.

entries.name: TokenRemovable
entries.title: Token — Removable
entries.description: Tokens with a dismiss button for selections the user can undo. Use in multi-select fields, active filters, or any list of user-chosen items.

entries.name: TokenizerShowcase
entries.title: Tokenizer
entries.description: A tokenizer with preset tags and search source.

entries.name: TokenizerClear
entries.title: Tokenizer — Clear
entries.description: Tokenizer with a built-in clear-all button for bulk removal of all selected tokens. On touch screens, clear through the sheet's Clear all.

entries.name: TokenizerCreatable
entries.title: Tokenizer — Creatable
entries.description: Free-text tokenizer for creating custom tags and a combined create-or-search pattern. Use when users need to enter values that may not exist in a predefined list.

entries.name: TokenizerEndContent
entries.title: Tokenizer — End Content
entries.description: Tokenizer with an action button in the end slot. Use for inline actions like applying selections alongside the input.

entries.name: TokenizerIcon
entries.title: Tokenizer — Icon
entries.description: Tokenizer with a leading search icon to visually reinforce the search behavior.

entries.name: TokenizerMaxEntries
entries.title: Tokenizer — Max Entries
entries.description: Tokenizer with a maximum selection limit. The input hides automatically when the limit is reached, preventing further additions.

entries.name: TokenizerOverflow
entries.title: Tokenizer — Overflow
entries.description: Tokenizer with overflow truncation when unfocused. Inline mode pushes content down on expand; layer mode overlays without shifting layout. Overflow modes apply to the inline field.

entries.name: TokenizerStates
entries.title: Tokenizer — States
entries.description: Tokenizer in disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use to communicate validation feedback or lock a selection from editing.

entries.name: ToolbarBulkActions
entries.title: Toolbar — Bulk Actions
entries.description: A compact toolbar with the muted variant for showing bulk selection actions. Use when the user selects multiple items in a list or table and needs quick access to batch operations.

entries.name: ToolbarCardHeader
entries.title: Toolbar — Card Header
entries.description: A toolbar as a card header with a left-aligned title and icon actions on the right. Use Toolbar instead of LayoutHeader when your card header has interactive actions; Toolbar adds start/end slot layout, keyboard navigation, and automatic size cascading. If the header is just a title with no actions, a LayoutHeader or…

entries.name: ToolbarSizes
entries.title: Toolbar — Sizes
entries.description: Small, medium, and large toolbars side by side. The size prop cascades to child buttons and inputs automatically. Use small in dense UIs like cards, medium for most cases, and large for spacious layouts.

entries.name: ToolbarWithTabs
entries.title: Toolbar — Tab Navigation
entries.description: A toolbar with tabs in the start slot and an action button at the end. Use as a card or section header when content is split into tabs with a primary action alongside.

entries.name: ToolbarTableFilter
entries.title: Toolbar — Table Filter
entries.description: Filter bar above a table: a search box leads the row, each field beside it is a closed trigger that doubles as its own filter chip — the bare field name unset, the whole clause once set — and the clauses fold from the end into a count as the row narrows, followed by a live result count, a clear all, and a column picke…

entries.name: ToolbarThreeSlot
entries.title: Toolbar — Three Slot
entries.description: A toolbar with start, center, and end content using the three-column grid layout. Use when you need a centered title or heading with navigation and actions on either side.

entries.name: TooltipActionBarTooltips
entries.title: Tooltip — Action Bar
entries.description: Tooltips on an action button bar with contextual descriptions.

entries.name: TooltipHookUsage
entries.title: Tooltip — Hook Usage
entries.description: Tooltip using the useTooltip hook for programmatic control.

entries.name: TooltipInlineTextTooltips
entries.title: Tooltip — Inline Text
entries.description: Tooltips on inline text terms for definitions.

entries.name: shell-top-nav
entries.title: Top Nav
entries.description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.

entries.name: TopNavCenteredNavigation
entries.title: TopNav — Centered Navigation
entries.description: Navigation layout with center-aligned nav items flanked by a logo heading and end actions.

entries.name: TopNavEnterpriseDashboard
entries.title: TopNav — Enterprise Dashboard
entries.description: Full-featured navigation bar with icon-labeled nav items, search, notifications, and a primary CTA.

entries.name: TopNavHoverMenu
entries.title: TopNav — Hover Menu
entries.description: Navigation bar with a hover-triggered dropdown menu showing product items with icons and descriptions.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenu
entries.title: TopNav — Mega Menu
entries.description: Marketing-style navigation with a full-width mega menu featuring product items and a promotional featured card.

entries.name: TopNavMultipleDropdowns
entries.title: TopNav — Multiple Dropdowns
entries.description: Navigation bar with multiple hover-triggered dropdown menus that auto-close when switching between them.

entries.name: TopNavWithLogo
entries.title: TopNav — With Logo
entries.description: Navigation bar with a branded logo icon, heading link, nav items, and a profile action.

entries.name: TopNavHeadingShowcase
entries.title: TopNavHeading
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavHeading with a logo and text, both as a plain display and as a clickable link.

entries.name: TopNavHeadingBasic
entries.title: TopNavHeading — Basic
entries.description: A product heading with a logo inside a TopNav, linked to the home page. Use as the leading brand element of a top navigation bar.

entries.name: TopNavItemShowcase
entries.title: TopNavItem
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavItem with selected, icon, disabled, and default states.

entries.name: TopNavItemBasic
entries.title: TopNavItem — Basic
entries.description: Navigation links inside a TopNav with one item marked as selected. Use for top-level pages of an application.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuShowcase
entries.title: TopNavMegaMenu
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenu with items and a featured card in the mega menu panel.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuBasic
entries.title: TopNavMegaMenu — Basic
entries.description: A mega menu trigger inside a TopNav that opens a panel of rich link items. Use when a navigation section has multiple destinations worth describing.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCardShowcase
entries.title: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard with a title, description, and CTA link inside a mega menu.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCardBasic
entries.title: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard — Basic
entries.description: A promotional card with a title, description, and call-to-action link. Pass it to the featured slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to highlight announcements.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuItemShowcase
entries.title: TopNavMegaMenuItem
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuItem with icons, titles, and descriptions inside a mega menu.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuItemBasic
entries.title: TopNavMegaMenuItem — Basic
entries.description: Rich link items with an icon, title, and description. Use inside the items slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to describe each destination.

entries.name: TopNavMenuShowcase
entries.title: TopNavMenu
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavMenu with a hover-triggered dropdown containing items with icons and descriptions.

entries.name: TopNavMenuBasic
entries.title: TopNavMenu — Basic
entries.description: A dropdown menu inside a TopNav built from an items array with icons and descriptions. Use to group related destinations under a single trigger.

entries.name: TreeListVariants
entries.title: Tree List — Variants
entries.description: The `variant` prop controls whether hierarchy guide lines are shown: `lineGuides` (default) draws connector lines between parent and child rows, while `noGuides` relies on indentation alone. It is orthogonal to `density`, which controls spacing.

entries.name: table-tree
entries.title: Tree Table
entries.description: Hierarchical table where every parent row rolls up from its children — a code repository whose folders show the newest commit beneath them, beside a detail sidebar and a rendered README. Columns resize, siblings sort within their own level, arrow keys walk the rows, and search prunes the tree to matching branches.

entries.name: TreeListFileTreeWithIcons
entries.title: TreeList — File Tree With Icons
entries.description: File browser tree with folder and document icons distinguishing directories from files.

entries.name: TreeListInteractiveSettings
entries.title: TreeList — Interactive Settings
entries.description: Settings tree with clickable items and a documentation link.

entries.name: TreeListMailboxTree
entries.title: TreeList — Mailbox Tree
entries.description: Email folder tree with unread badge counts.

entries.name: TreeListNavigationTree
entries.title: TreeList — Navigation Tree
entries.description: Navigation tree with a selected item for the current page.

entries.name: form-two-column
entries.title: Two-column Form
entries.description: Form split into two columns beneath a hero header: inputs on one flank, a persistent context panel opposite that stays put while the fields scroll. Flat, single submit, no steps.

entries.name: TypeaheadLimitedResults
entries.title: Typeahead — Limited Results
entries.description: Typeahead with a capped dropdown showing at most three results.

entries.name: TypeaheadSearchField
entries.title: Typeahead — Search Field
entries.description: Search input with icon and suggestions on focus.

entries.name: TypeaheadWithHelperText
entries.title: Typeahead — With Helper Text
entries.description: Typeahead with a description below the label.

entries.name: TypeaheadWithValidation
entries.title: Typeahead — With Validation
entries.description: Typeahead with an error validation message.

entries.name: TypeaheadItemShowcase
entries.title: TypeaheadItem
entries.description: Typeahead with custom item rendering using TypeaheadItem for avatars and descriptions.

entries.name: TypeaheadItemBasic
entries.title: TypeaheadItem — Basic
entries.description: A typeahead whose results are rendered with TypeaheadItem, adding a secondary description below each label. Use inside renderItem to keep custom results visually consistent.

entries.name: AnimatorPlayingCards
entries.title: useAnimator — Playing cards
entries.description: A playing card that follows a drag: a gentle release springs it back on its release velocity, and a quick flick throws it away with momentum before the next card is dealt. A Discard button moves it off from the keyboard, fading it in place under Reduce Motion, and the discard is announced. Built only on the public use…

entries.name: useAnnounceHookUsage
entries.title: useAnnounce — Filter Result Count
entries.description: A product filter that announces its result count with useAnnounce: once typing pauses for 500 ms, a screen reader hears "3 results" or "No results". The count has its own hasReplace instance, as the hook's docs advise for a changing value.

entries.name: AppShellMobileHookUsage
entries.title: useAppShellMobile — Custom Mobile Trigger
entries.description: Custom mobile navigation trigger built with useAppShellMobile. The trigger consumes the surrounding AppShell context instead of rendering its own shell.

entries.name: useCalendarConstraintsHookUsage
entries.title: useCalendarConstraints — Hotel Booking Range
entries.description: A hotel booking range picker enforcing season min/max dates, a 7-night maximum stay once check-in is picked, and a custom rule disabling closed Mondays.

entries.name: useCalendarDaysHookUsage
entries.title: useCalendarDays — Month Grid
entries.description: A compact custom month view: a seven-column table built from the weeks and dayNames that useCalendarDays returns, with only as many rows as the month needs. Days from the previous and next months are dimmed, and a Week starts on control (Sunday or Monday) reorders both the header and the grid.

entries.name: useCalendarNavigationHookUsage
entries.title: useCalendarNavigation — Month Pager
entries.description: A calendar month pager with previous/next navigation buttons, localized month-year label, and cross-month arrow key navigation using pendingFocus.

entries.name: useClickableContainerHookUsage
entries.title: useClickableContainer — Clickable Project Card
entries.description: A project card that useClickableContainer makes clickable anywhere: a click on the card follows its title link, while the Star button, the owner link and a text selection keep their own behavior, and Ctrl/Cmd+click or middle-click opens the project in a new tab.

entries.name: useClipboardHookUsage
entries.title: useClipboard — Share Link
entries.description: A share card that copies its invite link with useClipboard: the Copy button reads "Copied" while isCopied is true, a screen reader hears "Link copied", and a second press restarts the reset timer.

entries.name: CollapsibleHookUsage
entries.title: useCollapsible — Custom Disclosure
entries.description: Custom disclosure UI built directly with useCollapsible for headless open/close state.

entries.name: useCollatorHookUsage
entries.title: useCollator — Locale-aware Name Sort
entries.description: A list of names sorted with the compare function from useCollator: accented and lowercase names land where a reader expects, and switching the provider locale to Swedish moves Å and Ö after Z.

entries.name: useComboboxHookUsage
entries.title: useCombobox — Assign To Field
entries.description: An "Assign to" TextInput and a list of Item rows, with the field, listbox and option props from useCombobox spread onto them: typing filters a list of teammates, ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the active option while focus stays in the input, Enter picks it and Escape closes the list.

entries.name: useContainerRevealHookUsage
entries.title: useContainerReveal — Reveal-on-hover Row Actions
entries.description: File rows keep their edit/delete actions hidden at rest and reveal them on hover or keyboard focus via useContainerReveal; the actions stay mounted and in the tab order.

entries.name: useDirectionHookUsage
entries.title: useDirection — Hook Usage
entries.description: Demonstrates reading ambient text direction during render to draw a direction-aware canvas sparkline whose time axis runs from the logical inline start edge.

entries.name: DragToSnapPointsCard
entries.title: useDragToSnapPoints — Playing card on three places
entries.description: A playing card that a sideways drag moves between three places: a slow release settles on the nearest, a quick flick carries to the next, and a release moving back returns where it started. Buttons settle it from the keyboard, and the new place is announced. Built only on the public useDragToSnapPoints hook.

entries.name: useFocusTrapHookUsage
entries.title: useFocusTrap — Quick Edit Panel
entries.description: A custom quick-edit panel, not built on Dialog, that traps focus with useFocusTrap: focusFirst moves focus to its field on open, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it, Escape closes it through onEscape, and closing returns focus to the Quick edit button.

entries.name: useGridFocusHookUsage
entries.title: useGridFocus — Color Swatch Grid
entries.description: A color swatch picker in rows of eight with one Tab stop. useGridFocus moves focus with the arrow keys, Home and End, and Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End. Each swatch is a button, so Enter or a click picks it.

entries.name: useHotkeysHookUsage
entries.title: useHotkeys — Search and Help Shortcuts
entries.description: Page shortcuts registered with useHotkeys: "/" focuses the search field and "?" opens the shortcut help, while typing either character in the field just types it. A switch turns the single-key shortcuts off through isDisabled.

entries.name: HoverCardHookUsage
entries.title: useHoverCard — Profile Preview
entries.description: Custom profile preview using useHoverCard with direct trigger and render control.

entries.name: useIconHookUsage
entries.title: useIcon — Status Row
entries.description: A custom status row that draws the semantic success, warning and error icons with useIcon. The same row renders under the current theme and under a Theme whose icons override those three, and its icons change with no change to the component.

entries.name: useImageModeHookUsage
entries.title: useImageMode — Photo Caption
entries.description: A photo banner with a caption over the sky. useImageMode samples only the strip under the caption and MediaTheme switches the caption between light and dark text from the result. A Beach photo switch swaps a night photo for a bright beach photo, and while the new photo loads the caption keeps the dark fallback.

entries.name: useInputContainerHookUsage
entries.title: useInputContainer — Search Field Wrapper
entries.description: A custom search field wrapper with a leading search icon, padding and a trailing Clear button. useInputContainer puts focus in the input when the icon or the padding is clicked, while a click on Clear empties the field without the wrapper taking it over.

entries.name: useInputStatusIconHookUsage
entries.title: useInputStatusIcon — Coupon Code Status
entries.description: A custom bordered coupon-code input whose status affordance comes from useInputStatusIcon. A wrong code shows the error status and SAVE20 shows success. Switching the variant moves between a plain glyph with a message below (attached), no icon on the field (detached), and a focusable button whose tooltip keyboard and…

entries.name: useInteractiveRoleHookUsage
entries.title: useInteractiveRole — One Tile, Four Roles
entries.description: A polymorphic Tile used four ways: with an href it renders as a link, with an onClick as a button, with neither as plain content, and placed as a Popover trigger it becomes the trigger button through context — the resolution order in one place.

entries.name: useKeyboardHintHookUsage
entries.title: useKeyboardHint — Arrow-key Hint
entries.description: A custom five-star rating with one Tab stop calls useKeyboardHint directly: tabbing into it shows a "← → to navigate" hint, the first arrow press dismisses it, and tabbing back in does not show it again.

entries.name: LayerHookUsage
entries.title: useLayer — Anchored Layer
entries.description: Low-level anchored overlay rendered with useLayer and a custom surface.

entries.name: LightboxHookUsage
entries.title: useLightbox — Gallery Grid
entries.description: Photo gallery thumbnail grid using useLightbox for trigger props, keyboard navigation, and open state.

entries.name: useLinkComponentHookUsage
entries.title: useLinkComponent — Article Cards
entries.description: A custom Article card renders its title link with the component useLinkComponent resolves: the as prop first, then the nearest LinkProvider, then a native anchor. Inside a LinkProvider wired to a client-side router, the title navigates without a page load and updates the router location. With as="a" the title is a nat…

entries.name: useLinkifyHookUsage
entries.title: useLinkify — Links in a Comment Thread
entries.description: Plain-text comments where useLinkify turns the URL and the email address into Links, and a custom pattern turns issue references like #123 into tracker links — the patterns option in action. The comment without matches stays plain text.

entries.name: useListFocusHookUsage
entries.title: useListFocus — Recent Files
entries.description: A "Recent files" list of buttons with keyboard navigation from useListFocus: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move between rows, Home and End jump to the first and last row, focus wraps at the ends, and only one row is in the tab order.

entries.name: useLocaleHookUsage
entries.title: useLocale — Invoice Summary
entries.description: An invoice summary that formats its date and amount with Intl using the locale from useLocale, so switching the provider from English to German changes "Nov 2, 2026" and "$1,234.50" to "2. Nov. 2026" and "1.234,50 $" with no second locale source.

entries.name: useMergedRefsHookUsage
entries.title: useMergedRefs — AutoGrowTextArea
entries.description: An AutoGrowTextArea that forwards the caller's ref and also keeps its own ref to measure scrollHeight. The merged ref attaches both to the same textarea: it resizes itself while a parent button focuses it through the forwarded ref.

entries.name: useMultiComboboxHookUsage
entries.title: useMultiCombobox — Issue Labels
entries.description: A Labels field built on useMultiCombobox: typing filters the labels, the arrow keys move the active option while focus stays in the field, Enter or a click toggles a label and the list stays open, and selected labels show as removable tokens above the field.

entries.name: useOutlineFromDOMHookUsage
entries.title: useOutlineFromDOM — Article
entries.description: An article of headings and an Outline built from those headings through useOutlineFromDOM. "Add section" appends a heading, and a new entry that links to it appears in the outline.

entries.name: useOutlineFromMarkdownHookUsage
entries.title: useOutlineFromMarkdown — Docs Article
entries.description: A docs-style article with an Outline next to it, built from the same Markdown string through useOutlineFromMarkdown. "Add section" appends a heading to the string, and a new entry that links to it appears in the outline.

entries.name: useOverflowHookUsage
entries.title: useOverflow — Editor Toolbar
entries.description: Resize the card: useOverflow moves the toolbar actions that do not fit into a More menu, and shows them again when the card gets wider.

entries.name: useOverlayHookUsage
entries.title: useOverlay — Product Quick View
entries.description: A product card that is its own overlay container: useOverlay returns the ref and props to spread on the Card and a bottom strip to render once over the image. Hovering the card, or moving keyboard focus into it, slides in a Quick view button along the bottom of the image, and leaving hides it again. The image is a lin…

entries.name: PanDraggableBox
entries.title: usePanGesture — A draggable box
entries.description: The smallest pan example, in two forms side by side: the usePanGesture hook and the createPanGesture factory. The factory takes any element, React or not. Each card names its API, follows a drag from a finger, a mouse or a pen, and springs back, with the same StyleX styles. A starting point for a draggable tile, a swi…

entries.name: PanPlayingCard
entries.title: usePanGesture — A playing card (advanced)
entries.description: An advanced usePanGesture example: a playing card follows a drag, settles back on a gentle release and flies off on a quick flick, while a Discard button deals the next card from the keyboard and announces it. Drag, settle and throw are StyleX styles driven by React state. A pattern for swipe-to-dismiss, card decks an…

entries.name: PopoverHookUsage
entries.title: usePopover — Quick Actions
entries.description: Custom quick-actions popover using usePopover for trigger refs, ARIA attributes, and focus trapping.

entries.name: usePowerSearchConfigHookUsage
entries.title: usePowerSearchConfig — Filtered Directory Table
entries.description: A people directory with a PowerSearch bar over a Table: typed field definitions feed usePowerSearchConfig, returning the search config and an applyFilters helper that updates Table rows.

entries.name: usePressFeedbackHookUsage
entries.title: usePressFeedback — Pressable Card
entries.description: A Card made pressable with usePressFeedback: its marker and the interactionOverlayStyles backgroundImage overlay go straight on the Card, so a press darkens the card the way every Astryx pressable does; focusOutlineStyles.focusVisible gives it the shared Astryx focus ring for keyboard focus; and a click, Enter or Spac…

entries.name: useScrollableAreaHookUsage
entries.title: useScrollableArea — Activity Log Panel
entries.description: A fixed-height Activity log panel whose entries scroll up and down. useScrollableArea makes the panel a keyboard tab stop only when its entries overflow, reports which edges have more entries so a top or bottom shadow shows only there, and keeps a scroll that reaches the end from scrolling the page. Add entry flips th…

entries.name: useScrollLockHookUsage
entries.title: useScrollLock — Full-screen Mobile Menu
entries.description: A custom full-screen menu opened from a Menu button. useScrollLock pins the page behind it while it is open, so the page does not scroll or shift sideways, and closing the menu returns the reader to the same scroll position.

entries.name: useScrollOverflowHookUsage
entries.title: useScrollOverflow — Filter Strip Edge Fades
entries.description: A row of active filters that scrolls sideways. useScrollOverflow reports which edge has hidden filters, and the strip fades only that edge: none while every filter fits, the end at the start, both mid-scroll and the start at the end. Adding or removing a filter updates the fades, and in a right-to-left layout the star…

entries.name: CarouselSnapPaging
entries.title: useSnapPaging — Onboarding Pages
entries.description: Onboarding cards in a Carousel with hasSnap={useSnapPaging()}: under a finger or a trackpad swipe, each flick moves one view and rests on a card's start edge. A switch picks one view or one card per flick through the hook's pages option.

entries.name: useStreamingTextHookUsage
entries.title: useStreamingText — Streaming Response
entries.description: A chat-style reply card: while the response streams in bursts, useStreamingText reveals it steadily character by character; when streaming ends the full text snaps into place. Regenerate replays the stream.

entries.name: ColumnResizeHookUsage
entries.title: useTableColumnResize — Draggable Columns
entries.description: A Table using useTableColumnResize. Drag the right edge of any column header to resize; widths are committed on release. The last proportional column flexes to fill remaining space.

entries.name: useTableColumnSettingsStateHookUsage
entries.title: useTableColumnSettingsState — Column Visibility Picker
entries.description: A Table toolbar with a Columns menu of checkboxes: toggling Email updates active columns, Reset restores defaults, and the config is passed directly to useTableColumnSettings.

entries.name: ColumnsVirtualizationHookUsage
entries.title: useTableColumnsVirtualization - Wide Table
entries.description: A Table with 121 columns: a pinned Sensor column and 120 monthly readings at fixed widths. Scroll horizontally to mount the columns near the scroll position; the pinned column always renders. initialViewportWidth sizes only the first window. The caller keeps all data and columns; this hook does not virtualize rows.

entries.name: TableGroupedRowsTable
entries.title: useTableGroupedRows — Collapsible Groups
entries.description: A table grouped into collapsible sections with useTableGroupedRows. Each group gets a full-width header with a chevron, label, and member count; click to collapse/expand.

entries.name: InfiniteScrollHookUsage
entries.title: useTableInfiniteScroll - Load More Products
entries.description: A Table appends product batches automatically or through its Load more command. The caller owns the rows, loading state and Promise-returning request. The command disappears when all products are loaded.

entries.name: TableRowExpansionTable
entries.title: useTableRowExpansion — Tree Table
entries.description: A tree table using useTableRowExpansion with inherited columns. Child rows use the same columns as parents, indented by depth. Click the chevron or right-click to expand/collapse.

entries.name: TableRowIndexTable
entries.title: useTableRowIndex — Numbered Rows
entries.description: A table with a prepended row-number column via useTableRowIndex. Numbering is monospaced, right-aligned, and follows the rows the table renders.

entries.name: TableRowStatusTable
entries.title: useTableRowStatus - Semantic and Custom Markers
entries.description: A job table using both row-status paths: status resolves themed semantic glyphs and tones, while color stays a custom paint choice with an optional caller-selected icon or the stable dot.

entries.name: RowsVirtualizationHookUsage
entries.title: useTableRowsVirtualization - Fixed Height Rows
entries.description: A Table with 1,000 product rows inside a 320px-tall parent, which bounds its scroll area. Give the Table's parent a height, fixed or relative, or a flex child, so windowing can bound the rows; with no height every row renders. Scroll vertically to mount the visible rows. The caller keeps all data and columns; this hoo…

entries.name: useTableSortableStateHookUsage
entries.title: useTableSortableState — Multi-Sort Orders
entries.description: Orders with no sort code of their own: useTableSortableState owns the sort state, returns the sorted orders, and hands useTableSortable a ready config. Click Customer, then Shift-click Total, to sort by customer and then by total within each customer. A line above the orders reads the current sort state from the hook.

entries.name: StickyColumnsHookUsage
entries.title: useTableStickyColumns — Pinned Columns
entries.description: A Table using useTableStickyColumns to pin the Name column to the start edge and Status to the end edge. Scroll horizontally; pinned columns stay in view with a soft shadow over the scrolling content.

entries.name: TableTreeTable
entries.title: useTableTreeData: Tree Table
entries.description: A file-tree table built from nested data. useTableTreeState flattens the tree into the visible rows and owns the expanded set; useTableTreeData draws the per-level indent and the expand/collapse chevron in the tree column. The two hooks are designed to work together, so this one example covers both. hasExpandAllContro…

entries.name: useThemeHookUsage
entries.title: useTheme — Token Values
entries.description: Read resolved theme token values with useTheme for non-CSS consumers like SVG charts.

entries.name: useThemeNameHookUsage
entries.title: useThemeName — Active theme
entries.description: The name of the theme around the caller, read with useThemeName. The card is inside a theme named harbor.

entries.name: useToastHookUsage
entries.title: useToast — Settings Saved
entries.description: Shows a toast from the function useToast returns: a "Settings saved" confirmation with an Undo action, a uniqueID so pressing the button again replaces the toast instead of stacking another, and an error toast when the request fails.

entries.name: useTranslatorHookUsage
entries.title: useTranslator — Load More Footer
entries.description: A "Load more" footer under a list that gets its button label and its "Showing 3 of 9" count from the function useTranslator returns, with app message keys supplied per locale through InternationalizationProvider, so switching the provider to French changes both strings.

entries.name: useTreeFocusHookUsage
entries.title: useTreeFocus — Keyboard File Tree
entries.description: A custom file tree built from plain rows with tree roles. useTreeFocus gives it the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move over the visible rows, ArrowRight opens a folder or moves into it, ArrowLeft closes it or moves to its parent, Home and End jump to the ends, a typed letter jumps to a matching n…

entries.name: useTruncationHookUsage
entries.title: useTruncation — Tooltip on Cut-Off Text
entries.description: A narrow table column shows the full path in a Tooltip only where useTruncation reports the text is cut off; the short path shows none. One cell clamped to two lines shows the multi-line case.

entries.name: useTypeaheadHookUsage
entries.title: useTypeahead — Type to Focus a Country
entries.description: A country list of buttons with useListFocus arrow keys and useTypeahead type-to-focus. Typing "can" focuses Canada, pressing "b" again and again cycles through Belgium, Brazil and Bulgaria, and "e" finds Éire with the accent ignored. The hook only reports the match through onMatch, and useListFocus moves focus.

entries.name: form-wizard-vertical
entries.title: Vertical Wizard

entries.title: VisuallyHidden — Live Region
entries.description: A polite aria-live region announces visual-only state changes to assistive technology.

entries.name: VisuallyHiddenStructuralHeading
entries.title: VisuallyHidden — Structural Heading
entries.description: Give a visually implicit section an accessible name so screen-reader users can navigate to it.

entries.name: VisuallyHiddenSupplementaryContext
entries.title: VisuallyHidden — Supplementary Context
entries.description: Stat cards whose trend arrows get screen-reader-only text, so a change like +12% is read as an increase from last month. Use to make terse visual data accessible.

entries.name: VStackShowcase
entries.title: VStack
entries.description: Demonstrates VStack arranging items vertically with different gaps.

entries.name: VStackBasic
entries.title: VStack — Basic
entries.description: A heading and paragraphs stacked vertically with a consistent gap. Use VStack whenever siblings should flow top to bottom with even spacing.

entries.name: DrawerWidths
entries.title: Width budget: pixels or any CSS length
entries.description: Compare a numeric pixel width with rem and percentage lengths. The width budget also caps the drawer on mobile.

entries.name: DrawerHeaderWithCloseButton
entries.title: With close button
entries.description: Pass onOpenChange to render a close button that calls it with false. Drawer renders no close button of its own, so this is the usual visible way to close.

entries.name: DrawerHeaderSubtitleEndContent
entries.title: With subtitle and end content
entries.description: Add a subtitle under the title and put a status, such as a Badge, in endContent. The close button stays at the end of the row.
